        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          true))
      (block
        (assert (== v (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          true)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))

          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)

    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call dj_append_connection g p u v w i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)

      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))

(lemma dj_scan_next
  (params

  (ensures

      dist
      used
      (+ i 1)
      (or
        found
        (and
          (not (idx used i))
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best))))
      (if
        (and
          (not (idx used i))
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        i
        choice)
      (if
        (and
          (not (idx used i))

  (body))

    (== best (idx dist choice))
    (dj_minimum dist used choice))
  (body

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (idx used (idx p j)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
      (<=
        (idx dist (idx p k))
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step p k)
        (call dj_append_path
          g
          (take p k)
          start
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (+
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              w)))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))))))

(lemma dj_first_unsettled
  (params

  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p k)))

(lemma dj_relax_change
  (params

  (requires

    (< du (dj_inf))
    (dj_row_closed g before u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))

    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))

    (dj_one_update before after v (+ du w)))

  (params

  (ensures

              g start v (idx dist v)))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (dj_valid (view graph)))
    (assert (dj_unique (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (bd) 10000000001)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (bu) false)))
    (call dj_initialize
      (view graph) start dist used)
    (let-mut count i64 0)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (== (occurrences used true) count))
      (invariant
        (dj_base (view graph) start dist used))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut choice i64 0)
      (let-mut best i64 10000000001)
      (while (< scan_i n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i n)))
        (invariant
          (dj_scan
            dist used scan_i found choice best))
        (decreases (- n scan_i))
        (call dj_scan_next
          dist used scan_i found choice best)
        (if
          (and
            (not (idx used scan_i))
            (or
              (not found)
              (< (idx dist scan_i) best)))
          (block
            (set found true)
            (set choice scan_i)
            (set best (idx dist scan_i)))
          (block))
        (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
      (call dj_scan_complete
        dist used found choice best count)
      (if (< best 10000000001)
        (call dj_pick
          (view graph) start dist used choice)
        (block))
      (let deg i64
        (len (idx (field graph adj) choice)))
      (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
      (while (< edge_i deg)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i deg)))
        (invariant
          (dj_base (view graph) start dist used))
        (invariant
          (dj_minimum dist used choice))
        (invariant
          (== best (idx dist choice)))
        (invariant
          (dj_row_closed
            (view graph) dist choice edge_i best))
        (decreases (- deg edge_i))
        (let edge_value (tuple i64 i64)
          (idx
            (idx (field graph adj) choice)
            edge_i))
        (let vertex i64 (get edge_value 0))
        (let weight i64 (get edge_value 1))
        (call dj_edge_at
          (view graph) choice edge_i)
        (assert
          (and (>= weight 0) (<= weight 100000)))

(ghost-fn dj_one_update
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len after) (len before))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
        (and
          (== (idx after at) value)
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                  (!= v at))
                (== (idx after v) (idx before v)))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_bool_update
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len after) (len before))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
        (and
          (idx after at)
          (and
            (forall ((v int))
              (=> (and
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                    (!= v at))
                  (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))
            (==
              (occurrences after true)
              (+ (occurrences before true)
                 (if (idx before at) 0 1)))))))))

(lemma dj_occ_le_len
  (params (s (seq bool)) (x bool))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (occurrences s x))
      (<= (occurrences s x) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len (take s (- (len s) 1)) x)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          x))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s x)))))

(lemma dj_false_missing
  (params (s (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (not (idx s v)))
  (ensures
    (< (occurrences s true) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (< v (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_idx_take s (- (len s) 1) v)
        (call dj_false_missing
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          v)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          true))
      (block
        (assert (== v (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          true)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          true)))))

(lemma dj_true_from_full
  (params (s (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences s true) (len s))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures
    (idx s v))
  (body
    (if (idx s v)
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_false_missing s v)
        (assert false)))))

(lemma dj_all_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
          (idx s v))))
  (ensures
    (== (occurrences s true) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_all_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          true))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s true)))))

(lemma dj_weight_from_at
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_from_at row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_from_at (idx g u) v w 0 j)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      g
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (assert
        (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (connected g u v))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call dj_append_connection g p u v w i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_single_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start start 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (dj_witness g start start 0))))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (dj_witness g start u d)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start u d))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (call dj_append_path g p start u v w)
    (assert (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma dj_initialize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (dj_unique g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (or
            (and (== v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) 0))
            (and (!= v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (not (idx used v)))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used))
  (body
    (call dj_single_path g start)))

(lemma dj_scan_next
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len dist)))
    (dj_scan dist used i found choice best))
  (ensures
    (dj_scan
      dist
      used
      (+ i 1)
      (or
        found
        (and
          (not (idx used i))
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best))))
      (if
        (and
          (not (idx used i))
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        i
        choice)
      (if
        (and
          (not (idx used i))
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        (idx dist i)
        best)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (dj_scan dist used (len dist) found choice best)
    (== (occurrences used true) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len used))))
  (ensures
    found
    (== best (idx dist choice))
    (dj_minimum dist used choice))
  (body
    (if found
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_all_count used)
        (assert false)))
    (assert found)
    (assert (== best (idx dist choice)))
    (assert (dj_minimum dist used choice))))

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (idx used (idx p j)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
      (<=
        (idx dist (idx p k))
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step p k)
        (call dj_append_path
          g
          (take p k)
          start
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (+
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              w)))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))))))

(lemma dj_first_unsettled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (idx used (idx p j)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p k)))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p k)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist u)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight g p)
            (idx dist u))))
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (call dj_first_unsettled
          g start dist used u p (+ k 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx p k) u))
          (assert false))))))

(lemma dj_pick_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))

  (requires

    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (call dj_first_unsettled
      g start dist used u p 0)))

(lemma dj_pick
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (< (idx dist u) (dj_inf)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist g start u (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (assert
      (dj_witness g start u (idx dist u)))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))

        g start dist used u p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist
        g start u (idx dist u)))))

(lemma dj_relax_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start before used)
    (dj_minimum before used u)
    (== du (idx before u))
    (< du (dj_inf))
    (dj_row_closed g before u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (not (idx used v))
    (< (+ du w) (idx before v))
    (dj_one_update before after v (+ du w)))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start after used)
    (dj_row_closed g after u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (call dj_path_extend g start u v w du)))

(lemma dj_relax_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dj_row_closed g dist u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (or
      (== du (dj_inf))
      (or
        (idx used v)
        (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (if (== du (dj_inf))
      (block)
      (if (idx used v)
        (block
          (call dj_path_extend g start u v w du)
          (assert
            (is_shortest_dist
              g start v (idx dist v)))
          (assert
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w))))
        (assert
          (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))))

(lemma dj_finalize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist before)
    (dj_minimum dist before u)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (len (idx g u)) du)
    (dj_bool_update before after u)
    (== (occurrences before true) count)
    (or
      (== du (dj_inf))
      (is_shortest_dist g start u du)))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist after)
    (== (occurrences after true) (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx before u)))
    (assert
      (== (occurrences after true) (+ count 1)))
    (assert (dj_closed g dist after))
    (assert (dj_base g start dist after))))

  (params

  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))

  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_true_from_full used v))))

(lemma dj_reachable_finite
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))
          (idx used v)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p k))
        (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call dj_reachable_finite
        g start dist used p (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_final_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len used)))
          (idx used x)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (if (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=> (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false))
      (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dj_reachable_finite
        g start dist used p (- (len p) 1)))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))

    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_all_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s 1)))))

(lemma dj_weight_from_at
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_from_at row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_from_at (idx g u) v w 0 j)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      g
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (assert
        (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (connected g u v))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call dj_append_connection g p u v w i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_single_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start start 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (dj_witness g start start 0))))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (dj_witness g start u d)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start u d))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (call dj_append_path g p start u v w)
    (assert (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma dj_initialize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (dj_unique g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (or
            (and (== v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) 0))
            (and (!= v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx used v) 0))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used))
  (body
    (assert (dj_bits used))
    (call dj_single_path g start)))

(lemma dj_scan_next
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len dist)))
    (dj_scan dist used i found choice best))
  (ensures
    (dj_scan
      dist
      used
      (+ i 1)
      (or
        found
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best))))
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        i
        choice)
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        (idx dist i)
        best)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (dj_scan dist used (len dist) found choice best)
    (== (occurrences used 1) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len used))))
  (ensures
    found
    (== best (idx dist choice))
    (dj_minimum dist used choice))
  (body
    (if found
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_all_count used)
        (assert false)))
    (assert found)
    (assert (== best (idx dist choice)))
    (assert (dj_minimum dist used choice))))

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
      (<=
        (idx dist (idx p k))
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step p k)
        (call dj_append_path
          g
          (take p k)
          start
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (+
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              w)))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))))))

(lemma dj_first_unsettled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (if (== (idx used (idx p k)) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p k)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist u)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight g p)
            (idx dist u))))
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (call dj_first_unsettled
          g start dist used u p (+ k 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx p k) u))
          (assert false))))))

(lemma dj_pick_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (call dj_first_unsettled
      g start dist used u p 0)))

(lemma dj_pick
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (< (idx dist u) (dj_inf)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist g start u (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (assert
      (dj_witness g start u (idx dist u)))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dj_pick_path
        g start dist used u p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist
        g start u (idx dist u)))))

(lemma dj_relax_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start before used)
    (dj_minimum before used u)
    (== du (idx before u))
    (< du (dj_inf))
    (dj_row_closed g before u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (== (idx used v) 0)
    (< (+ du w) (idx before v))
    (dj_one_update before after v (+ du w)))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start after used)
    (dj_row_closed g after u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (call dj_path_extend g start u v w du)))

(lemma dj_relax_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dj_row_closed g dist u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (or
      (== du (dj_inf))
      (or
        (== (idx used v) 1)
        (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (if (== du (dj_inf))
      (block)
      (if (== (idx used v) 1)
        (block
          (call dj_path_extend g start u v w du)
          (assert
            (is_shortest_dist
              g start v (idx dist v)))
          (assert
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w))))
        (assert
          (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))))

(lemma dj_finalize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist before)
    (dj_minimum dist before u)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (len (idx g u)) du)
    (dj_used_update before after u)
    (== (occurrences before 1) count)
    (or
      (== du (dj_inf))
      (is_shortest_dist g start u du)))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist after)
    (== (occurrences after 1) (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx before u) 0))
    (assert
      (== (occurrences after 1) (+ count 1)))
    (assert (dj_closed g dist after))
    (assert (dj_base g start dist after))))

(lemma dj_all_used
  (params
    (used (seq int))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences used 1) count)
    (== count (len used)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))
          (== (idx used v) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_one_from_full used v))))

(lemma dj_reachable_finite
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))
          (== (idx used v) 1)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p k))
        (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call dj_reachable_finite
        g start dist used p (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_final_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len used)))
          (== (idx used x) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (if (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=> (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false))
      (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dj_reachable_finite
        g start dist used p (- (len p) 1)))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (dj_valid (view graph)))
    (assert (dj_unique (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (bd) 10000000001)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut used (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (bu) 0)))
    (call dj_initialize
      (view graph) start dist used)
    (let-mut count i64 0)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (== (occurrences used 1) count))
      (invariant
        (dj_base (view graph) start dist used))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut choice i64 0)
      (let-mut best i64 10000000001)
      (while (< scan_i n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i n)))
        (invariant
          (dj_scan
            dist used scan_i found choice best))
        (decreases (- n scan_i))
        (call dj_scan_next
          dist used scan_i found choice best)
        (if
          (and
            (== (idx used scan_i) 0)
            (or
              (not found)
              (< (idx dist scan_i) best)))
          (block
            (set found true)
            (set choice scan_i)
            (set best (idx dist scan_i)))
          (block))
        (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
      (call dj_scan_complete
        dist used found choice best count)
      (if (< best 10000000001)
        (call dj_pick
          (view graph) start dist used choice)
        (block))
      (let deg i64
        (len (idx (field graph adj) choice)))
      (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
      (while (< edge_i deg)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i deg)))
        (invariant
          (dj_base (view graph) start dist used))
        (invariant
          (dj_minimum dist used choice))
        (invariant
          (== best (idx dist choice)))
        (invariant
          (dj_row_closed
            (view graph) dist choice edge_i best))
        (decreases (- deg edge_i))
        (let edge_value (tuple i64 i64)
          (idx
            (idx (field graph adj) choice)
            edge_i))
        (let vertex i64 (get edge_value 0))
        (let weight i64 (get edge_value 1))
        (call dj_edge_at
          (view graph) choice edge_i)
        (assert
          (and (>= weight 0) (<= weight 100000)))
        (if (< best 10000000001)
          (block
            (let alternate i64 (+ best weight))
            (if
              (and
                (== (idx used vertex) 0)
                (< alternate (idx dist vertex)))
              (block
                (ghost-let before_dist (seq int) dist)
                (set-idx dist vertex alternate)
                (assert
                  (dj_one_update
                    before_dist dist vertex alternate))
                (call dj_relax_change
                  (view graph)
                  start
                  before_dist
                  dist
                  used
                  choice
                  edge_i
                  vertex
                  weight
                  best))
              (call dj_relax_skip
                (view graph)
                start
                dist
                used
                choice
                edge_i
                vertex
                weight
                best)))
          (call dj_relax_skip
            (view graph)
            start
            dist
            used
            choice
            edge_i
            vertex
            weight
            best))
        (set edge_i (+ edge_i 1)))
      (assert
        (or
          (== best 10000000001)
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view graph)
            start
            choice
            best)))
      (ghost-let before_used (seq int) used)
      (set-idx used choice 1)
      (assert
        (dj_used_update before_used used choice))
      (call dj_finalize

      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx dists v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (bf_bounded_path g start v k p) false)))
            (case (some d)
              (and
                (exists ((p (seq int)))
                  (and (bf_bounded_path g start v k p)
                       (== (path_weight g p) d)))
                (forall ((p (seq int)))
                  (=> (bf_bounded_path g start v k p)
                      (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_numeric ((dists (seq (option int))) (k int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dists)))
        (match (idx dists v)
          (case (none) true)
          (case (some d)
            (and (>= d (neg (* k 100000)))
                 (<= d (* k 100000)))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_result_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dists (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dists) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx dists v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and (is_path g p)
                         (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_done ((x int) (j int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))))

(ghost-fn bf_updo
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (v int) (value (option int))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len after) (len before))
      (and
        (== (idx after v) value)
        (forall ((w int))
          (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len before))) (!= w v))
              (== (idx after w) (idx before w))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_scan
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len before) (len g))
           (== (len after) (len g)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx after v)
            (case (none)
              (and
                (is none (idx before v))
                (forall ((x int) (j int))
                  (=> (and
                        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
                        (and
                          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x))))
                          (and
                            (bf_done x j u i)
                            (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) v))))
                    (is none (idx before x))))))
            (case (some d)
              (and
                (and
                  (match (idx before v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some old) (<= d old)))
                  (forall ((x int) (j int))
                    (=> (and
                          (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
                          (and
                            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x))))
                            (and
                              (bf_done x j u i)
                              (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) v))))
                      (match (idx before x)
                        (case (none) true)
                        (case (some source_d)
                          (<= d (+ source_d
                                   (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))))
                (or
                  (bf_finite (idx before v) d)
                  (exists ((x int) (j int) (source_d int))
                    (and
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
                        (and
                          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x))))
                          (and
                            (bf_done x j u i)
                            (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) v))))
                      (and
                        (bf_finite (idx before x) source_d)
                        (== d (+ source_d
                                 (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1)))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_strict
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
        (and
          (bf_finite (idx after v) d)
          (match (idx before v)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some old) (< d old))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_relaxed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (bf_scan g before after (len g) 0)))

(lemma bf_scan_initial
  (params

  (requires
    (== (len before) (len g))
    (== before after))

(lemma bf_scan_keep_edge
  (params

    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (i int) (du int) (v int) (w int) (old int))

    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))

    (bf_finite (idx after v) old)

(lemma bf_scan_set_edge
  (params

    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after0 (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (i int) (du int) (v int) (w int))

    (match (idx after0 v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old) (< (+ du w) old))))
  (ensures
    (bf_scan g before after u (+ i 1))
    (bf_strict before after))

(lemma bf_scan_strict_keep
  (params

(lemma bf_zero_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_bounded_path g start v 0 p))
  (ensures
    (== v start)
    (== (path_weight g p) 0))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))

(lemma bf_initial_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dists (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dists) (len g))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
          (== (idx dists x)
              (if (== x start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dists v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (bf_bounded_path g start v 0 p) false)))
      (case (some d)
        (and
          (exists ((p (seq int)))
            (and (bf_bounded_path g start v 0 p)
                 (== (path_weight g p) d)))
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=> (bf_bounded_path g start v 0 p)
                (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))
  (body
    (if (== v start)
      (block
        (assert (bf_bounded_path g start start 0 (seq-lit start)))
        (forall ((p (seq int))) (call bf_zero_path g start start p)))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int))) (call bf_zero_path g start v p))))))

(lemma bf_initial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dists (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dists) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx dists v)
              (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
  (ensures
    (bf_optimal g start dists 0)
    (bf_numeric dists 0))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call bf_initial_at g start dists v))))

(lemma bf_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g
             (idx p (- (len p) 2))
             (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) (- (len p) 1)))))

(lemma bf_append
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p)
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))))

(lemma bf_round_sound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_optimal g start before k)
    (bf_relaxed g before after)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx after v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some d)
        (exists ((p (seq int)))
          (and (bf_bounded_path g start v (+ k 1) p)
               (== (path_weight g p) d))))))
  (body
    (match (idx after v)
      (case (none) (block))
      (case (some d)
        (if (bf_finite (idx before v) d)
          (block
            (obtain ((p (seq int)))
              (and (bf_bounded_path g start v k p)
                   (== (path_weight g p) d))))
          (block
            (obtain ((u int) (i int) (du int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))
                (and
                  (bf_finite (idx before u) du)
                  (== d (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
            (obtain ((q (seq int)))
              (and (bf_bounded_path g start u k q)
                   (== (path_weight g q) du)))
            (assert (connected g u v))
            (call bf_append g q v)))))))

(lemma bf_round_lower
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_optimal g start before k)
    (bf_relaxed g before after)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (bf_bounded_path g start v (+ k 1) p))
  (ensures
    (match (idx after v)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight g p) d))))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call bf_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (let last_u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (let last_v int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_w int)) (has_edge g last_u last_v edge_w))))))

(lemma bf_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_optimal g start before k)
    (bf_relaxed g before after))
  (ensures
    (bf_optimal g start after (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call bf_round_sound g start before after k v))
    (forall ((v int) (p (seq int)))
      (call bf_round_lower g start before after k v p))))

(lemma bf_numeric_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (bf_numeric before k)
    (bf_relaxed g before after)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len after))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx after v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some d)
        (and
          (>= d (neg (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
          (<= d (* (+ k 1) 100000))))))
  (body
    (match (idx after v)
      (case (none) (block))
      (case (some d)
        (if (bf_finite (idx before v) d)
          (block)
          (block
            (obtain ((u int) (i int) (du int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))
                (and
                  (bf_finite (idx before u) du)
                  (== d (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
            (assert
              (has_edge g u v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))

(lemma bf_numeric_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (bf_numeric before k)
    (bf_relaxed g before after))
  (ensures
    (bf_numeric after (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call bf_numeric_at g before after k v))))

(lemma bf_path_fixed_lower
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dists (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int))
    (m int))
  (requires
    (bf_relaxed g dists dists)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p)))
    (exists ((d0 int))
      (and (bf_finite (idx dists start) d0) (<= d0 0))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((d int))
      (and
        (bf_finite (idx dists (idx p m)) d)
        (<= d (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call bf_path_fixed_lower g start dists p (- m 1))
        (obtain ((du int))
          (and
            (bf_finite (idx dists (idx p (- m 1))) du)
            (<= du (path_weight g (take p m)))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w)))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_stable_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dists (seq (option int)))
    (k int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_optimal g start dists k)
    (bf_relaxed g dists dists)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dists v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path g p)
                   (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (obtain ((start_d int))
      (and
        (bf_finite (idx dists start) start_d)
        (<= start_d 0)))
    (match (idx dists v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_path_fixed_lower
            g start dists p (- (len p) 1))))
      (case (some d)
        (block
          (obtain ((witness (seq int)))
            (and
              (bf_bounded_path g start v k witness)
              (== (path_weight g witness) d)))
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call bf_path_fixed_lower
              g start dists p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma bf_stable_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dists (seq (option int)))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (>= k 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_optimal g start dists k)
    (bf_relaxed g dists dists))
  (ensures
    (bf_result_ok g start dists))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_stable_at g start dists k v))))

(ghost-fn bf_in_range ((p (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
          (and (<= 0 (idx p i)) (< (idx p i) n))))))

(ghost-fn bf_simple ((p (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
            (< j (len p)))
          (!= (idx p i) (idx p j))))))

(lemma bf_simple_bound
  (params
    (p (seq int))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (bf_in_range p n)
    (bf_simple p))
  (ensures
    (<= (len p) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (block)
      (if (> (len p) n)
        (block
          (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
          (let removed int (last p))
          (ghost-let lowered (seq int)
            (seq-build (len q)
              (fn (i)
                (if (< (idx q i) removed)
                  (idx q i)
                  (- (idx q i) 1)))))
          (call bf_simple_bound lowered (- n 1)))
        (block)))))

(lemma bf_path_in_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
          (and
            (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (bf_in_range p (len g)))
  (body))

(lemma bf_simplify_or_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p))
  (ensures
    (or
      (has_negative_cycle g)
      (exists ((q (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g q)
            (and
              (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0))
              (== (idx q (- (len q) 1))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
          (and
            (bf_simple q)
            (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p)))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block)
      (block
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call bf_prefix g p)
        (call bf_simplify_or_cycle g prefix)))))

(lemma bf_nth_change_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (> n 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
          (and
            (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))
    (bf_optimal g start before (- n 1))
    (bf_optimal g start after n)
    (bf_relaxed g before after)
    (bf_strict before after))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
        (and
          (bf_finite (idx after v) d)
          (match (idx before v)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some old) (< d old))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_path g start v n p)
        (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (call bf_path_in_range g start p)
    (call bf_simplify_or_cycle g p)
    (if (has_negative_cycle g)
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((q (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g q)
              (and
                (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0))
                (== (idx q (- (len q) 1))
                    (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
            (and
              (bf_simple q)
              (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p)))))
        (call bf_path_in_range g start q)
        (call bf_simple_bound q n)
        (assert (bf_bounded_path g start v (- n 1) q))))))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_v)
          (if (== init_v start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (call bf_initial (view graph) start distances)
    (let-mut pass i64 0)
    (while true
      (invariant (and (<= 0 pass) (< pass n)))
      (invariant (== (len distances) n))
