  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (dj_bits before)
      (and
        (== (len after) (len before))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
          (and
            (== (idx after at) 1)
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=> (and
                      (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                      (!= v at))
                    (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))
              (and
                (dj_bits after)
                (==
                  (occurrences after 1)
                  (+ (occurrences before 1)
                     (if (== (idx before at) 1) 0 1)))))))))))

(lemma dj_occ_le_len
  (params (s (seq int)) (x int))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (occurrences s x))
      (<= (occurrences s x) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len (take s (- (len s) 1)) x)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          x))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s x)))))

(lemma dj_one_missing
  (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (!= (idx s v) 1))
  (ensures
    (< (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (< v (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_idx_take s (- (len s) 1) v)
        (call dj_one_missing
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          v)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (assert (== v (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          1)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1)))))

(lemma dj_one_from_full
  (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx s v) 1))
  (body
    (if (== (idx s v) 1)
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_one_missing s v)
        (assert false)))))

(lemma dj_all_count
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
          (== (idx s v) 1))))
  (ensures
    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_all_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s 1)))))

(lemma dj_weight_from_at
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_from_at row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_from_at (idx g u) v w 0 j)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      g
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (assert
        (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (connected g u v))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call dj_append_connection g p u v w i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_single_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start start 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (dj_witness g start start 0))))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (dj_witness g start u d)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start u d))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (call dj_append_path g p start u v w)
    (assert (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma dj_initialize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (dj_unique g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (or
            (and (== v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) 0))
            (and (!= v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx used v) 0))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used))
  (body
    (assert (dj_bits used))
    (call dj_single_path g start)))

(lemma dj_scan_next
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len dist)))
    (dj_scan dist used i found choice best))
  (ensures
    (dj_scan
      dist
      used
      (+ i 1)
      (or
        found
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best))))
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        i
        choice)
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        (idx dist i)
        best)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (dj_scan dist used (len dist) found choice best)
    (== (occurrences used 1) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len used))))
  (ensures
    found
    (== best (idx dist choice))
    (dj_minimum dist used choice))
  (body
    (if found
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_all_count used)
        (assert false)))
    (assert found)
    (assert (== best (idx dist choice)))
    (assert (dj_minimum dist used choice))))

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
      (<=
        (idx dist (idx p k))
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step p k)
        (call dj_append_path
          g
          (take p k)
          start
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (+
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              w)))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))))))

(lemma dj_first_unsettled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (if (== (idx used (idx p k)) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p k)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist u)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight g p)
            (idx dist u))))
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (call dj_first_unsettled
          g start dist used u p (+ k 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx p k) u))
          (assert false))))))

(lemma dj_pick_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (call dj_first_unsettled
      g start dist used u p 0)))

(lemma dj_pick
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (< (idx dist u) (dj_inf)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist g start u (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (assert
      (dj_witness g start u (idx dist u)))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dj_pick_path
        g start dist used u p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist
        g start u (idx dist u)))))

(lemma dj_relax_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start before used)
    (dj_minimum before used u)
    (== du (idx before u))
    (< du (dj_inf))
    (dj_row_closed g before u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (== (idx used v) 0)
    (< (+ du w) (idx before v))
    (dj_one_update before after v (+ du w)))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start after used)
    (dj_row_closed g after u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (call dj_path_extend g start u v w du)))

(lemma dj_relax_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dj_row_closed g dist u k du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (or
      (== du (dj_inf))
      (or
        (== (idx used v) 1)
        (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (if (== du (dj_inf))
      (block)
      (if (== (idx used v) 1)
        (block
          (call dj_path_extend g start u v w du)
          (assert
            (is_shortest_dist
              g start v (idx dist v)))
          (assert
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w))))
        (assert
          (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))))

(lemma dj_finalize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist before)
    (dj_minimum dist before u)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (len (idx g u)) du)
    (dj_used_update before after u)
    (== (occurrences before 1) count)
    (or
      (== du (dj_inf))
      (is_shortest_dist g start u du)))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist after)
    (== (occurrences after 1) (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx before u) 0))
    (assert
      (== (occurrences after 1) (+ count 1)))
    (assert (dj_closed g dist after))
    (assert (dj_base g start dist after))))

(lemma dj_all_used
  (params
    (used (seq int))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences used 1) count)
    (== count (len used)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))
          (== (idx used v) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_one_from_full used v))))

(lemma dj_reachable_finite
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))
          (== (idx used v) 1)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p k))
        (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call dj_reachable_finite
        g start dist used p (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_final_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len used)))
          (== (idx used x) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (if (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=> (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false))
      (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dj_reachable_finite
        g start dist used p (- (len p) 1)))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (dj_valid (view graph)))
    (assert (dj_unique (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (bd) 10000000001)))

              (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
              (+ (path_weight g p)
                 (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 1))))))))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_lookup g u edge_index)))

(lemma candidate_realizes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p)
        (== (path_weight g p) x))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start v steps (idx distances v)))
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start v steps old_path)
            (== (path_weight g old_path) x)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) old_path)))
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start source steps
            (idx distances source)))
        (obtain ((source_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start source steps source_path)
            (== (path_weight g source_path) source_value)))
        (call append_edge_path
          g source_path start source v edge_index)
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1)
            (concat source_path (seq-lit v))))))))

(lemma path_has_candidate
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures
    (exists ((x int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x)
        (<= x (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if (<= (- (len p) 1) steps)
      (match (idx distances v)
        (case (none)
          (assert false))
        (case (some old_value)
          (block
            (assert
              (bounded_dist g start v steps
                (idx distances v)))
            (assert
              (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix_path (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start previous steps prefix_path))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge g previous v edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 1)
                  edge_weight))))
        (call edge_weight_lookup g previous edge_index)
        (match (idx distances previous)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some previous_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (bounded_dist g start previous steps
                  (idx distances previous)))
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0
                  (+ previous_value edge_weight)))))))))

(lemma choice_none_excludes_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (none))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma choice_some_lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (chosen int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some chosen))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures (<= chosen (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma candidate_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (>= x (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
      (<= x (* (+ steps 1) 100000))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= source_value (neg (* steps 100000)))
            (<= source_value (* steps 100000))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1) 100000)))))))

(lemma finish_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (== (len next) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (bounded_dist g start v (+ steps 1) (idx next v))
      (match (idx next v)
        (case (none) true)
        (case (some value)
          (and
            (>= value (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
            (<= value (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (block
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call choice_none_excludes_path
              g start distances steps v p))))
      (case (some chosen_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 chosen_value))
          (call candidate_realizes
            g start distances steps v chosen_value)
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call choice_some_lower_path
              g start distances steps v chosen_value p))
          (call candidate_range
            g start distances steps v chosen_value))))))

(lemma finish_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (changed bool))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) changed))
  (ensures
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1)))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call finish_vertex
        g start distances next steps v))))

(lemma fixed_from_track
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) false))
  (ensures
    (and (== next distances) (fixed_dist g distances)))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (assert (== (len next) (len distances)))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len distances)))
            (== (idx next v) (idx distances v)))))
    (assert (== next distances))))

(lemma fixed_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (i int) (source_value int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (fixed_dist g distances)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (idx distances u) (some source_value)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is some
        (idx distances (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (<=
        (field
          (idx distances (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          value)
        (+ source_value
           (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let target int
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let candidate int
      (+ source_value
         (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len g))))
    (assert
      (seen_candidate g distances target (len g) 0 candidate))
    (assert
      (cursor_choice g distances target (len g) 0
        (idx distances target)))))

(lemma lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (fixed_dist g distances)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx distances (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some value)
        (<= value (path_weight g p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (> (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call lower_path
          g start distances steps prefix)
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let endpoint int
          (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0)
                endpoint)))
        (assert (is some (idx distances previous)))
        (ghost-let previous_value int
          (field (idx distances previous) value))
        (call fixed_edge
          g distances previous edge_index previous_value)
        (call edge_weight_lookup
          g previous edge_index))
      (block))))

(lemma stable_solution
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (fixed_dist g distances))
  (ensures
    (solution g start distances))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call lower_path
        g start distances steps p))))

(lemma final_shorter_heavier
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (new_value int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some new_value))
    (!= (some new_value) (idx distances v))
    (admissible g start v steps p))
  (ensures
    (> (path_weight g p) new_value))
  (body
    (match (idx distances v)
      (case (none)
        (assert false))
      (case (some old_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value))
          (assert (< new_value old_value)))))))

(lemma final_witness_long
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (and
          (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
          (forall ((q (seq int)))
            (=>
              (admissible g start v steps q)
              (> (path_weight g q)
                 (path_weight g p))))))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (match (idx distances v)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value))
              (assert false)))))
      (case (some new_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 new_value))
          (call candidate_realizes
            g start distances steps v new_value)
          (obtain ((long_path (seq int)))
            (and
              (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) long_path)
              (== (path_weight g long_path) new_value)))
          (forall ((short_path (seq int)))
            (call final_shorter_heavier
              g start distances steps v new_value short_path))
          (assert
            (== (- (len long_path) 1) (+ steps 1))))))))

(lemma path_repeats
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (body))

(lemma cycle_decomposition
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
    (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (is_path g (cycle_part p i j))
        (and
          (> (len (cycle_part p i j)) 1)
          (== (idx (cycle_part p i j) 0)
              (idx (cycle_part p i j)
                   (- (len (cycle_part p i j)) 1)))))
      (and
        (is_path g (cut_cycle p i j))
        (and
          (== (idx (cut_cycle p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
          (and
            (== (idx (cut_cycle p i j)
                     (- (len (cut_cycle p i j)) 1))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (and
              (== (len (cut_cycle p i j))
                  (- (len p) (- j i)))
              (==
                (path_weight g p)
                (+ (path_weight g (cut_cycle p i j))
                   (path_weight g (cycle_part p i j))))))))))
  (body))

(lemma repeated_path_has_negative_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (end int)
    (steps int) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) end)
    (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=>
        (admissible g start end steps q)
        (> (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p))))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call cycle_decomposition g p i j)
    (assert
      (admissible g start end steps
        (cut_cycle p i j)))
    (assert
      (< (path_weight g (cut_cycle p i j))
         (path_weight g p)))
    (assert
      (< (path_weight g (cycle_part p i j)) 0))
    (assert
      (has_negative_cycle g))))

(lemma long_min_path_has_negative_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (end int)
    (steps int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) end)
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=>
        (admissible g start end steps q)
        (> (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p))))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call path_repeats g p)
    (obtain ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
    (call repeated_path_has_negative_cycle
      g start end steps p i j)))

(lemma final_improvement_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v)))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call final_witness_long
      g start distances next steps v)
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g witness_path)
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path (- (len witness_path) 1)) v)))
        (and
          (== (- (len witness_path) 1) (+ steps 1))
          (forall ((short_path (seq int)))
            (=>
              (admissible g start v steps short_path)
              (> (path_weight g short_path)
                 (path_weight g witness_path)))))))
    (call long_min_path_has_negative_cycle
      g start v steps witness_path)))

(lemma changed_last_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) true))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v))))
    (call final_improvement_cycle
      g start distances next steps v)))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph rows)
        (block
          (assert (== g rows))
          (assert (wf_edges g))
          (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
          (call bounded_edges_from_spec g)
          (assert (bounded_edges g))
          (let n i64 (len rows))
          (assert (and (> n 0) (<= n 100000)))
          (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
            (seq-build n
              (fn (initial_index)
                (if (== initial_index start)
                  (some 0)
                  (none)))))
          (assert (initial_dist g start distances))
          (call initial_round g start distances)
          (let-mut round i64 0)
          (while true
            (invariant (and (<= 0 round) (< round n)))
            (invariant (round_ok g start distances round))
            (decreases (- n round))
            (let-mut next (vec (option i64)) (vec-new))
            (let-mut changed bool false)
            (assert (== (len distances) (len g)))
            (call track_empty g distances next)
            (let-mut vertex i64 0)
            (while (< vertex n)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 vertex) (<= vertex n)))
              (invariant
                (round_track
                  g distances next vertex changed))
              (decreases (- n vertex))
              (let-mut best (option i64)
                (idx distances vertex))
              (let-mut local_changed bool false)
              (call choice_start g distances vertex)
              (let-mut source_vertex i64 0)
              (while (< source_vertex n)
                (invariant
                  (and
                    (<= 0 source_vertex)
                    (<= source_vertex n)))
                (invariant
                  (cursor_choice
                    g distances vertex source_vertex 0 best))
                (invariant
                  (== local_changed
                      (!= best (idx distances vertex))))
                (decreases (- n source_vertex))
                (let degree i64
                  (len (idx rows source_vertex)))
                (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
                (while (< edge_index degree)
                  (invariant
                    (and
                      (<= 0 edge_index)
                      (<= edge_index degree)))
                  (invariant
                    (cursor_choice
                      g distances vertex source_vertex
                      edge_index best))
                  (invariant
                    (== local_changed
                        (!= best (idx distances vertex))))
                  (decreases (- degree edge_index))
                  (let arc (tuple i64 i64)
                    (idx (idx rows source_vertex) edge_index))
                  (let arc_to i64 (get arc 0))
                  (let arc_weight i64 (get arc 1))
                  (assert
                    (has_edge
                      g source_vertex arc_to arc_weight))
                  (assert
                    (and
                      (>= arc_weight -100000)
                      (<= arc_weight 100000)))
                  (ghost-let before_best (option int) best)
                  (if (== arc_to vertex)
                    (match (idx distances source_vertex)
                      (case (none)
                        (call step_no_source
                          g distances vertex source_vertex
                          edge_index before_best))
                      (case (some source_value)
                        (block
                          (assert
                            (and
                              (>= source_value
                                  (neg (* round 100000)))
                              (<= source_value
                                  (* round 100000))))
                          (assert
                            (in_i64
                              (+ source_value arc_weight)))
                          (let candidate i64
                            (+ source_value arc_weight))
                          (match best
                            (case (none)
                              (block
                                (set best (some candidate))
                                (set local_changed true)
                                (call step_into_none
                                  g distances vertex source_vertex
                                  edge_index source_value)))
                            (case (some current_value)
                              (if (< candidate current_value)
                                (block
                                  (set best (some candidate))
                                  (set local_changed true)
                                  (call step_improves
                                    g distances vertex source_vertex
                                    edge_index source_value
                                    current_value))
                                (call step_keeps
                                  g distances vertex source_vertex
                                  edge_index source_value
                                  current_value)))))))
                    (call step_not_target
                      g distances vertex source_vertex
                      edge_index before_best))
                  (assert
                    (step_value
                      g distances vertex source_vertex
                      edge_index before_best best))
                  (assert

    (and (== (len s1) (len s0))
         (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
    (and
      (== (idx s1 v) x)
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s0))) (!= k v))
            (== (idx s1 k) (idx s0 k))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_updw
  ((s0 (seq (seq int))) (s1 (seq (seq int))) (v int) (x (seq int))) bool
  (body (and
    (and (== (len s1) (len s0))
         (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
    (and
      (== (idx s1 v) x)
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s0))) (!= k v))
            (== (idx s1 k) (idx s0 k))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_witnesses
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and
    (== (len wit) (len dist))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (>= (idx dist v) 0))
          (and
            (is_path g (idx wit v))
            (and
              (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start)
              (and
                (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)
                (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_settled
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq int)) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (< v (len done)))
          (idx done v))
        (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))))

(ghost-fn dj_closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
    (=> (and
          (has_edge g u v w)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len done)))
            (idx done u)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (and
            (>= (idx dist v) 0)
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_partial
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int))
   (u int) (i int) (du int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int))
    (=> (and
          (and (<= 0 e) (< e i))
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
        (and
          (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) 0)
          (<= (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0))
              (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_dist_range ((dist (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
        (and
          (>= (idx dist v) -1)
          (<= (idx dist v) 10000100000))))))

(lemma dj_scan_weight
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (i int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (dj_has_from row v w i))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- (len row) i))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (and (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))))
    (if (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
      (block
        (assert (== i j))
        (assert (== (get (idx row i) 1) w)))
      (block
        (assert (> j i))
        (assert (dj_has_from row v w (+ i 1)))
        (call dj_scan_weight row v w (+ i 1))))))

(lemma dj_edge_value
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (assert (dj_has_from (idx g u) v w 0))
    (call dj_scan_weight (idx g u) v w 0)))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call dj_edge_value g u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_path_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)
      (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
    (>= (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)) 0)
    (== (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))
        (+ (path_weight g (take p m))
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w))
    (call dj_edge_value g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w)
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert
      (== (take p (+ m 1))
          (concat (take p m) (seq-lit (idx p m)))))
    (call dj_path_extend
      g (take p m) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w)))

(lemma dj_vertex_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len g))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call dj_vertex_range g start p (- m 1))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w))
        (obtain ((e int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1)))
                   (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 e)
                   (< e (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) e) 0)
                  (idx p m))
              (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) e) 1) w)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_closed g dist done)
    (dj_choice dist done u)
    (!= u -1)
    (== (idx dist u) du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (or
      (>= (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) du)
      (and
        (idx done (idx p m))
        (and
          (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0)
          (<= (idx dist (idx p m))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call dj_vertex_range g start p m)
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (take p 1) (seq-lit start)))
        (if (idx done start)
          (assert
            (and
              (idx done (idx p 0))
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (idx p 0)) 0)
                (<= (idx dist (idx p 0))
                    (path_weight g (take p 1))))))
          (block
            (assert (dj_eligible dist done start))
            (assert (>= (path_weight g (take p 1)) du)))))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist done u du p (- m 1))
        (call dj_path_step g p m)
        (if (>= (path_weight g (take p m)) du)
          (assert
            (>= (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) du))
          (block
            (assert (idx done (idx p (- m 1))))
            (assert
              (<= (idx dist (idx p (- m 1)))
                  (path_weight g (take p m))))
            (assert
              (has_edge g
                (idx p (- m 1))
                (idx p m)
                (get_edge_weight g
                  (idx p (- m 1))
                  (idx p m))))
            (assert
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0)
                (<= (idx dist (idx p m))
                    (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))))))
            (if (idx done (idx p m))
              (assert
                (and
                  (idx done (idx p m))
                  (and
                    (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0)
                    (<= (idx dist (idx p m))
                        (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))))))
              (block
                (assert (dj_eligible dist done (idx p m)))
                (assert
                  (>= (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) du)))))))))

(lemma dj_settle_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))

    (dj_choice dist done u)
    (!= u -1))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist g start u (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dj_prefix_bound
        g start dist done u (idx dist u) p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert
      (exists ((p (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
          (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=> (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
            (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))))))

(lemma dj_reachable_known
  (params

  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))

  (ensures
    (and
      (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0)
      (idx done (idx p m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call dj_vertex_range g start p m)
    (if (> m 0)

        (call dj_reachable_known

(spec dj_find_min
  (params
    (dist (ref (slice i64)))
    (done (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (r i64))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len done)))
  (ensures (dj_choice dist done r))
  (effects))

(def dj_find_min
  (body
    (let-mut best i64 -1)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len dist))))
      (invariant
        (if (== best -1)
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v i))
                  (and (not (idx done v)) (>= (idx dist v) 0)))
                false))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 best) (< best i))
            (and
              (not (idx done best))
              (and
                (>= (idx dist best) 0)
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=> (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v i))
                        (and
                          (not (idx done v))
                          (>= (idx dist v) 0)))
                      (<= (idx dist best) (idx dist v)))))))))
      (decreases (- (len dist) i))
      (if (and
            (not (idx done i))
            (and
              (>= (idx dist i) 0)
              (or
                (== best -1)
                (< (idx dist i) (idx dist best)))))
        (set best i)
        (block))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (return best)))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (i) -1)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (j) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (k) (seq-lit start))))
    (let-mut ((next i64))
      (call dj_find_min (borrow dist) (borrow done)))
    (while (!= next -1)
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (dj_dist_range dist))
      (invariant (dj_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (dj_settled (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (dj_closed (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (dj_choice dist done next))
      (decreases (occurrences done false))
      (let u i64 next)
      (let du i64 (idx dist u))
      (call dj_settle_vertex
        (view graph) start dist done wit u)
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (== (len dist) n))
        (invariant (== (len done) n))
        (invariant (== (len wit) n))
        (invariant (== (idx dist u) du))
        (invariant (not (idx done u)))
        (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
        (invariant (dj_dist_range dist))
        (invariant (dj_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
        (invariant (dj_settled (view graph) start dist done))
        (invariant (dj_closed (view graph) dist done))
        (invariant (dj_partial (view graph) dist u i du))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
        (let w i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))
        (assert (has_edge (view graph) u v w))

  bool
  (body
    (and
      (dj_valid g)
      (and
        (== (len dist) (len g))
        (and
          (== (len used) (len g))
          (forall ((u int) (i int))
            (=> (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                  (and (== (idx used u) 1)
                       (< (idx dist u) (dj_inf))))
                (and
                  (< (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                     (dj_inf))
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                    (+ (idx dist u)
                       (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_row_closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq int))
   (u int)
   (k int)
   (du int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (dj_valid g)
      (and
        (== (len dist) (len g))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
            (forall ((i int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k))
                       (< du (dj_inf)))
                  (and
                    (< (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                       (dj_inf))
                    (<=
                      (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_base
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (dist (seq int))
   (used (seq int)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (dj_valid g)
      (and
        (dj_unique g)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
          (and
            (== (len dist) (len g))
            (and
              (== (len used) (len g))
              (and
                (dj_bits used)
                (and
                  (== (idx dist start) 0)
                  (and
                    (forall ((v int))
                      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                          (and (<= 0 (idx dist v))
                               (<= (idx dist v) (dj_inf)))))
                    (and
                      (forall ((v int))
                        (=> (and
                              (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                              (< (idx dist v) (dj_inf)))
                            (dj_witness g start v (idx dist v))))
                      (and
                        (forall ((v int))
                          (=> (and
                                (and
                                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                                  (== (idx used v) 1))
                                (< (idx dist v) (dj_inf)))
                              (is_shortest_dist
                                g start v (idx dist v))))
                        (and
                          (dj_closed g dist used)
                          (dj_ordered dist used))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_minimum
  ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq int)) (u int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len used))
      (and
        (dj_bits used)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
          (and
            (== (idx used u) 0)
            (forall ((v int))
              (=> (and
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
                    (== (idx used v) 0))
                  (<= (idx dist u) (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_scan
  ((dist (seq int))
   (used (seq int))
   (limit int)
   (found bool)
   (choice int)
   (best int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len used))
      (and
        (dj_bits used)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len dist)))
          (if found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 choice) (< choice limit))
              (and
                (== (idx used choice) 0)
                (and
                  (== best (idx dist choice))
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=> (and
                          (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                          (== (idx used v) 0))
                        (<= best (idx dist v)))))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                  (== (idx used v) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_one_update
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len after) (len before))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
        (and
          (== (idx after at) value)
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                  (!= v at))
                (== (idx after v) (idx before v)))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_used_update
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (dj_bits before)
      (and
        (== (len after) (len before))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
          (and
            (== (idx after at) 1)
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=> (and
                      (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                      (!= v at))
                    (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))
              (and
                (dj_bits after)
                (==
                  (occurrences after 1)
                  (+ (occurrences before 1)
                     (if (== (idx before at) 1) 0 1)))))))))))

(lemma dj_occ_le_len
  (params (s (seq int)) (x int))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (occurrences s x))
      (<= (occurrences s x) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len (take s (- (len s) 1)) x)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          x))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s x)))))

(lemma dj_one_missing
  (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (!= (idx s v) 1))
  (ensures
    (< (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (< v (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_idx_take s (- (len s) 1) v)
        (call dj_one_missing
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          v)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (assert (== v (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          1)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1)))))

(lemma dj_one_from_full
  (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx s v) 1))
  (body
    (if (== (idx s v) 1)
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_one_missing s v)
        (assert false)))))

(lemma dj_all_count
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
          (== (idx s v) 1))))
  (ensures
    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_all_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s 1)))))

(lemma dj_weight_from_at
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_from_at row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_from_at (idx g u) v w 0 j)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      g
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_path_vertex_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_path_vertex_range g p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (assert
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                   (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  1)
                w))))
        (assert
          (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
               (< (idx p k) (len g))))))))

(lemma dj_append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (assert
        (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (connected g u v))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call dj_append_connection g p u v w i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_single_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start start 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (dj_witness g start start 0))))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (dj_witness g start u d)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start u d))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (call dj_append_path g p start u v w)
    (assert (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma dj_shortest_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (v int)
    (d int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (is_shortest_dist g start v d)
    (dj_witness g start v candidate))
  (ensures
    (<= d candidate))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start v candidate))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (== (path_weight g p) candidate)))
    (assert (>= (path_weight g p) d))))

(lemma dj_row_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_closed g dist u k du)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (=>
      (< du (dj_inf))
      (and
        (< (idx dist v) (dj_inf))
        (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
  (ensures
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (assert (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))))

(lemma dj_level_raise
  (params (dist (seq int)) (count int))
  (requires
    (dj_level dist count)
    (>= count 0))
  (ensures
    (dj_level dist (+ count 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_level_update
  (params
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (at int)
    (value int)
    (limit int))
  (requires
    (dj_level before limit)
    (dj_one_update before after at value)
    (< value (dj_inf))
    (<= value (* limit 100000)))
  (ensures
    (dj_level after limit))
  (body))

(lemma dj_initialize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (dj_unique g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (or
            (and (== v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) 0))
            (and (!= v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx used v) 0))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_level dist 0))
  (body
    (assert (dj_bits used))
    (assert (dj_ordered dist used))
    (assert (dj_level dist 0))
    (call dj_single_path g start)))

(lemma dj_scan_next
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len dist)))
    (dj_scan dist used i found choice best))
  (ensures
    (dj_scan
      dist
      used
      (+ i 1)
      (or
        found
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best))))
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        i
        choice)
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        (idx dist i)
        best)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (dj_scan dist used (len dist) found choice best)
    (== (occurrences used 1) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len used))))
  (ensures
    found
    (== best (idx dist choice))
    (dj_minimum dist used choice))
  (body
    (if found
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_all_count used)
        (assert false)))
    (assert found)
    (assert (== best (idx dist choice)))
    (assert (dj_minimum dist used choice))))

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
      (<=
        (idx dist (idx p k))
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call dj_path_vertex_range g p k)
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step p k)
        (call dj_append_path
          g
          (take p k)
          start
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (+
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              w)))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))))))

(lemma dj_first_unsettled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int))

(lemma dj_path_prefix
