            (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
               (get_edge_weight g
                 (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))
  (body))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (weight_from
        (idx g u)
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
        j)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i j))
  (body
    (if (< j i)
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (call weight_from_index g u i (+ j 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma edge_weight_lookup
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (call weight_from_index g u i 0)))

(lemma append_edge_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
    (start int) (u int) (v int) (edge_index int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 edge_index) (< edge_index (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 0) v))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (and
        (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
        (and
          (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                   (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
              v)
          (and
            (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
            (==
              (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
              (+ (path_weight g p)
                 (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 1))))))))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_lookup g u edge_index)))

(lemma candidate_realizes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p)
        (== (path_weight g p) x))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start v steps (idx distances v)))
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start v steps old_path)
            (== (path_weight g old_path) x)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) old_path)))
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start source steps
            (idx distances source)))
        (obtain ((source_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start source steps source_path)
            (== (path_weight g source_path) source_value)))
        (call append_edge_path
          g source_path start source v edge_index)
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1)
            (concat source_path (seq-lit v)))))))))

(lemma path_has_candidate
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures
    (exists ((x int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x)
        (<= x (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if (<= (- (len p) 1) steps)
      (match (idx distances v)
        (case (none)
          (assert false))
        (case (some old_value)
          (block
            (assert
              (bounded_dist g start v steps
                (idx distances v)))
            (assert
              (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix_path (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start previous steps prefix_path))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge g previous v edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 1)
                  edge_weight))))
        (call edge_weight_lookup g previous edge_index)
        (match (idx distances previous)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some previous_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (bounded_dist g start previous steps
                  (idx distances previous)))
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0
                  (+ previous_value edge_weight)))))))))

(lemma choice_none_excludes_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (none))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma choice_some_lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (chosen int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some chosen))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures (<= chosen (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma candidate_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (>= x (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
      (<= x (* (+ steps 1) 100000))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= source_value (neg (* steps 100000)))
            (<= source_value (* steps 100000))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1) 100000)))))))

(lemma finish_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (== (len next) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (bounded_dist g start v (+ steps 1) (idx next v))
      (match (idx next v)
        (case (none) true)
        (case (some value)
          (and
            (>= value (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
            (<= value (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (block
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call choice_none_excludes_path
              g start distances steps v p))))
      (case (some chosen_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 chosen_value))
          (call candidate_realizes
            g start distances steps v chosen_value)
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call choice_some_lower_path
              g start distances steps v chosen_value p))
          (call candidate_range
            g start distances steps v chosen_value))))))

(lemma finish_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (changed bool))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) changed))
  (ensures
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1)))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call finish_vertex
        g start distances next steps v))))

(lemma fixed_from_track
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) false))
  (ensures
    (and (== next distances) (fixed_dist g distances)))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (assert (== (len next) (len distances)))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len distances)))
            (== (idx next v) (idx distances v)))))
    (assert (== next distances))))

(lemma fixed_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (i int) (source_value int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (fixed_dist g distances)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (idx distances u) (some source_value)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is some
        (idx distances (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (<=
        (field
          (idx distances (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          value)
        (+ source_value
           (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let target int
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let candidate int
      (+ source_value
         (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len g))))
    (assert
      (seen_candidate g distances target (len g) 0 candidate))
    (assert
      (cursor_choice g distances target (len g) 0
        (idx distances target)))))

(lemma lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (fixed_dist g distances)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx distances (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some value)
        (<= value (path_weight g p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (> (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call lower_path
          g start distances steps prefix)
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let endpoint int
          (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0)
                endpoint)))
        (assert (is some (idx distances previous)))
        (ghost-let previous_value int
          (field (idx distances previous) value))
        (call fixed_edge
          g distances previous edge_index previous_value)
        (call edge_weight_lookup
          g previous edge_index))
      (block))))

(lemma stable_solution
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (fixed_dist g distances))
  (ensures
    (solution g start distances))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call lower_path
        g start distances steps p))))

(lemma final_shorter_heavier
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (new_value int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some new_value))
    (!= (some new_value) (idx distances v))
    (admissible g start v steps p))
  (ensures
    (> (path_weight g p) new_value))
  (body
    (match (idx distances v)
      (case (none)
        (assert false))
      (case (some old_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value))
          (assert (< new_value old_value)))))))

(lemma final_witness_long
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (and
          (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
          (forall ((q (seq int)))
            (=>
              (admissible g start v steps q)
              (> (path_weight g q)
                 (path_weight g p))))))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (match (idx distances v)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value))
              (assert false)))))
      (case (some new_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 new_value))
          (call candidate_realizes
            g start distances steps v new_value)
          (obtain ((long_path (seq int)))
            (and
              (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) long_path)
              (== (path_weight g long_path) new_value)))
          (forall ((short_path (seq int)))
            (call final_shorter_heavier
              g start distances steps v new_value short_path))
          (assert
            (== (- (len long_path) 1) (+ steps 1))))))))

(lemma path_repeats
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (body))

(lemma cycle_decomposition
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
    (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (is_path g (cycle_part p i j))
        (and
          (> (len (cycle_part p i j)) 1)
          (== (idx (cycle_part p i j) 0)
              (idx (cycle_part p i j)
                   (- (len (cycle_part p i j)) 1)))))
      (and
        (is_path g (cut_cycle p i j))
        (and
          (== (idx (cut_cycle p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
          (and
            (== (idx (cut_cycle p i j)
                     (- (len (cut_cycle p i j)) 1))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (and
              (== (len (cut_cycle p i j))
                  (- (len p) (- j i)))
              (==
                (path_weight g p)
                (+ (path_weight g (cut_cycle p i j))
                   (path_weight g (cycle_part p i j))))))))))
  (body))

(lemma repeated_path_has_negative_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (end int)
    (steps int) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) end)
    (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=>
        (admissible g start end steps q)
        (> (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p))))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call cycle_decomposition g p i j)
    (assert
      (admissible g start end steps
        (cut_cycle p i j)))
    (assert
      (< (path_weight g (cut_cycle p i j))
         (path_weight g p)))
    (assert
      (< (path_weight g (cycle_part p i j)) 0))
    (assert
      (has_negative_cycle g))))

(lemma long_min_path_has_negative_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (end int)
    (steps int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) end)
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=>
        (admissible g start end steps q)
        (> (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p))))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call path_repeats g p)
    (obtain ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
    (call repeated_path_has_negative_cycle
      g start end steps p i j)))

(lemma final_improvement_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v)))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call final_witness_long
      g start distances next steps v)
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g witness_path)
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path (- (len witness_path) 1)) v)))
        (and
          (== (- (len witness_path) 1) (+ steps 1))
          (forall ((short_path (seq int)))
            (=>
              (admissible g start v steps short_path)
              (> (path_weight g short_path)
                 (path_weight g witness_path)))))))
    (call long_min_path_has_negative_cycle
      g start v steps witness_path)))

(lemma changed_last_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) true))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v))))
    (call final_improvement_cycle
      g start distances next steps v)))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph rows)
        (block
          (assert (== g rows))
          (assert (wf_edges g))
          (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
          (call bounded_edges_from_spec g)
          (assert (bounded_edges g))
          (let n i64 (len rows))
          (assert (and (> n 0) (<= n 100000)))
          (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
            (seq-build n
              (fn (initial_index)
                (if (== initial_index start)
                  (some 0)
                  (none)))))
          (assert (initial_dist g start distances))
          (call initial_round g start distances)
          (let-mut round i64 0)
          (while true
            (invariant (and (<= 0 round) (< round n)))
            (invariant (round_ok g start distances round))
            (decreases (- n round))
            (let-mut next (vec (option i64)) (vec-new))
            (let-mut changed bool false)
            (assert (== (len distances) (len g)))
            (call track_empty g distances next)
            (let-mut vertex i64 0)
            (while (< vertex n)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 vertex) (<= vertex n)))
              (invariant
                (round_track
                  g distances next vertex changed))
              (decreases (- n vertex))
              (let-mut best (option i64)
                (idx distances vertex))
              (let-mut local_changed bool false)
              (call choice_start g distances vertex)
              (let-mut source_vertex i64 0)
              (while (< source_vertex n)
                (invariant
                  (and
                    (<= 0 source_vertex)
                    (<= source_vertex n)))
                (invariant
                  (cursor_choice

    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p)
        (== (path_weight g p) x))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start v steps (idx distances v)))
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start v steps old_path)
            (== (path_weight g old_path) x)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) old_path)))
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start source steps
            (idx distances source)))
        (obtain ((source_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start source steps source_path)
            (== (path_weight g source_path) source_value)))
        (call append_edge_path
          g source_path start source v edge_index)
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1)
            (concat source_path (seq-lit v)))))))))

(lemma path_has_candidate
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures
    (exists ((x int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x)
        (<= x (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if (<= (- (len p) 1) steps)
      (match (idx distances v)
        (case (none)
          (assert false))
        (case (some old_value)
          (block
            (assert
              (bounded_dist g start v steps
                (idx distances v)))
            (assert
              (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix_path (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start previous steps prefix_path))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge g previous v edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 1)
                  edge_weight))))
        (call edge_weight_lookup g previous edge_index)
        (match (idx distances previous)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some previous_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (bounded_dist g start previous steps
                  (idx distances previous)))
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0
                  (+ previous_value edge_weight)))))))))

(lemma choice_none_excludes_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (none))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma choice_some_lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (chosen int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some chosen))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures (<= chosen (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma candidate_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (>= x (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
      (<= x (* (+ steps 1) 100000))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= source_value (neg (* steps 100000)))
            (<= source_value (* steps 100000))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1) 100000)))))))

(lemma finish_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (== (len next) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (bounded_dist g start v (+ steps 1) (idx next v))
      (match (idx next v)
        (case (none) true)
        (case (some value)
          (and
            (>= value (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
            (<= value (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (block
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call choice_none_excludes_path
              g start distances steps v p))))
      (case (some chosen_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 chosen_value))
          (call candidate_realizes
            g start distances steps v chosen_value)
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call choice_some_lower_path
              g start distances steps v chosen_value p))
          (call candidate_range
            g start distances steps v chosen_value))))))

(lemma finish_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)

  (ensures
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1)))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call finish_vertex
        g start distances next steps v))))

(lemma fixed_from_track
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) false))
  (ensures
    (and (== next distances) (fixed_dist g distances)))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (assert (== (len next) (len distances)))

      (forall ((v int))

(lemma fixed_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (i int) (source_value int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (fixed_dist g distances)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (idx distances u) (some source_value)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is some
        (idx distances (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (<=
        (field
          (idx distances (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          value)
        (+ source_value
           (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let target int
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let candidate int
      (+ source_value
         (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len g))))
    (assert
      (seen_candidate g distances target (len g) 0 candidate))
    (assert
      (cursor_choice g distances target (len g) 0
        (idx distances target)))))

(lemma lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (fixed_dist g distances)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx distances (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some value)
        (<= value (path_weight g p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (> (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call lower_path
          g start distances steps prefix)
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let endpoint int
          (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0)
                endpoint)))
        (assert (is some (idx distances previous)))
        (ghost-let previous_value int
          (field (idx distances previous) value))
        (call fixed_edge
          g distances previous edge_index previous_value)
        (call edge_weight_lookup
          g previous edge_index))
      (block))))

(lemma stable_solution
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)

  (requires

    (fixed_dist g distances))
  (ensures

  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call lower_path
        g start distances steps p))))

(lemma final_shorter_heavier
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (new_value int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some new_value))
    (!= (some new_value) (idx distances v))
    (admissible g start v steps p))
  (ensures
    (> (path_weight g p) new_value))
  (body
    (match (idx distances v)
      (case (none)
        (assert false))
      (case (some old_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value))
          (assert (< new_value old_value)))))))

(lemma final_witness_long
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (and
          (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
          (forall ((q (seq int)))
            (=>
              (admissible g start v steps q)
              (> (path_weight g q)
                 (path_weight g p))))))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (match (idx distances v)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value))
              (assert false)))))
      (case (some new_value)
        (block
          (assert
            (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 new_value))
          (call candidate_realizes
            g start distances steps v new_value)
          (obtain ((long_path (seq int)))
            (and
              (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) long_path)
              (== (path_weight g long_path) new_value)))
          (forall ((short_path (seq int)))
            (call final_shorter_heavier
              g start distances steps v new_value short_path))
          (assert
            (== (- (len long_path) 1) (+ steps 1))))))))

(lemma path_repeats
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (body))

(lemma cycle_decomposition
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
    (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (is_path g (cycle_part p i j))
        (and
          (> (len (cycle_part p i j)) 1)
          (== (idx (cycle_part p i j) 0)
              (idx (cycle_part p i j)
                   (- (len (cycle_part p i j)) 1)))))
      (and
        (is_path g (cut_cycle p i j))
        (and
          (== (idx (cut_cycle p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
          (and
            (== (idx (cut_cycle p i j)
                     (- (len (cut_cycle p i j)) 1))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (and
              (== (len (cut_cycle p i j))
                  (- (len p) (- j i)))
              (==
                (path_weight g p)
                (+ (path_weight g (cut_cycle p i j))
                   (path_weight g (cycle_part p i j))))))))))
  (body))

(lemma repeated_path_has_negative_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (end int)
    (steps int) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) end)
    (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=>
        (admissible g start end steps q)
        (> (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p))))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call cycle_decomposition g p i j)
    (assert
      (admissible g start end steps
        (cut_cycle p i j)))
    (assert
      (< (path_weight g (cut_cycle p i j))
         (path_weight g p)))
    (assert
      (< (path_weight g (cycle_part p i j)) 0))
    (assert
      (has_negative_cycle g))))

(lemma long_min_path_has_negative_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (end int)
    (steps int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) end)
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (== (- (len p) 1) (+ steps 1))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=>
        (admissible g start end steps q)
        (> (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p))))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call path_repeats g p)
    (obtain ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
    (call repeated_path_has_negative_cycle
      g start end steps p i j)))

(lemma final_improvement_cycle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (idx next v))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v)))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call final_witness_long
      g start distances next steps v)
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g witness_path)
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path (- (len witness_path) 1)) v)))
        (and
          (== (- (len witness_path) 1) (+ steps 1))
          (forall ((short_path (seq int)))
            (=>
              (admissible g start v steps short_path)
              (> (path_weight g short_path)
                 (path_weight g witness_path)))))))
    (call long_min_path_has_negative_cycle
      g start v steps witness_path)))

(lemma changed_last_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (bounded_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (== (len distances) (len g))
    (round_track g distances next (len g) true))
  (ensures
    (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_round g distances next (len g)))
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v))))
    (call final_improvement_cycle
      g start distances next steps v)))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph rows)
        (block
          (assert (== g rows))
          (assert (wf_edges g))
          (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
          (call bounded_edges_from_spec g)
          (assert (bounded_edges g))
          (let n i64 (len rows))
          (assert (and (> n 0) (<= n 100000)))
          (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
            (seq-build n
              (fn (initial_index)
                (if (== initial_index start)
                  (some 0)
                  (none)))))
          (assert (initial_dist g start distances))
          (call initial_round g start distances)
          (let-mut round i64 0)
          (while true
            (invariant (and (<= 0 round) (< round n)))
            (invariant (round_ok g start distances round))
            (decreases (- n round))
            (let-mut next (vec (option i64)) (vec-new))
            (let-mut changed bool false)
            (assert (== (len distances) (len g)))
            (call track_empty g distances next)
            (let-mut vertex i64 0)
            (while (< vertex n)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 vertex) (<= vertex n)))
              (invariant
                (round_track
                  g distances next vertex changed))
              (decreases (- n vertex))
              (let-mut best (option i64)
                (idx distances vertex))
              (let-mut local_changed bool false)
              (call choice_start g distances vertex)
              (let-mut source_vertex i64 0)
              (while (< source_vertex n)
                (invariant
                  (and
                    (<= 0 source_vertex)
                    (<= source_vertex n)))
                (invariant
                  (cursor_choice
                    g distances vertex source_vertex 0 best))
                (invariant
                  (== local_changed
                      (!= best (idx distances vertex))))
                (decreases (- n source_vertex))
                (let degree i64
                  (len (idx rows source_vertex)))
                (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
                (while (< edge_index degree)
                  (invariant
                    (and
                      (<= 0 edge_index)
                      (<= edge_index degree)))
                  (invariant
                    (cursor_choice
                      g distances vertex source_vertex
                      edge_index best))
                  (invariant
                    (== local_changed
                        (!= best (idx distances vertex))))
                  (decreases (- degree edge_index))
                  (let arc (tuple i64 i64)
                    (idx (idx rows source_vertex) edge_index))
                  (let arc_to i64 (get arc 0))
                  (let arc_weight i64 (get arc 1))
                  (assert
                    (has_edge
                      g source_vertex arc_to arc_weight))
                  (assert
                    (and
                      (>= arc_weight -100000)
                      (<= arc_weight 100000)))
                  (ghost-let before_best (option int) best)
                  (if (== arc_to vertex)
                    (match (idx distances source_vertex)
                      (case (none)
                        (call step_no_source
                          g distances vertex source_vertex
                          edge_index before_best))
                      (case (some source_value)
                        (block
                          (assert
                            (and
                              (>= source_value
                                  (neg (* round 100000)))
                              (<= source_value
                                  (* round 100000))))
                          (assert
                            (in_i64
                              (+ source_value arc_weight)))
                          (let candidate i64
                            (+ source_value arc_weight))
                          (match best
                            (case (none)
                              (block
                                (set best (some candidate))
                                (set local_changed true)
                                (call step_into_none
                                  g distances vertex source_vertex
                                  edge_index source_value)))
                            (case (some current_value)
                              (if (< candidate current_value)
                                (block
                                  (set best (some candidate))
                                  (set local_changed true)
                                  (call step_improves
                                    g distances vertex source_vertex
                                    edge_index source_value
                                    current_value))
                                (call step_keeps
                                  g distances vertex source_vertex
                                  edge_index source_value
                                  current_value)))))))
                    (call step_not_target
                      g distances vertex source_vertex
                      edge_index before_best))
                  (assert
                    (step_value
                      g distances vertex source_vertex
                      edge_index before_best best))
                  (assert
                    (== local_changed
                        (!= best (idx distances vertex))))
                  (call choice_step
                    g distances vertex source_vertex
                    edge_index before_best best)
                  (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
                (call choice_next_row
                  g distances vertex source_vertex best)
                (assert
                  (== local_changed
                      (!= best (idx distances vertex))))
                (set source_vertex (+ source_vertex 1)))
              (ghost-let before_next
                (seq (option int)) next)
              (ghost-let before_changed bool changed)
              (push next best)
              (if local_changed

                (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)
                (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_settled
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq int)) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (< v (len done)))

        (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))))

          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len done)))
            (idx done u)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))

            (>= (idx dist v) 0)
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w))))))))

  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int))

  (body (forall ((e int))

          (and (<= 0 e) (< e i))
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
        (and
          (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) 0)
          (<= (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0))
              (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))))))))

(lemma dj_scan_weight
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (i int))

    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (dj_has_from row v w i))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- (len row) i))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (and (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))))
    (if (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
      (block
        (assert (== i j))
        (assert (== (get (idx row i) 1) w)))
      (block
        (assert (> j i))
        (assert (dj_has_from row v w (+ i 1)))
        (call dj_scan_weight row v w (+ i 1))))))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires

    (is_path g p)

  (ensures

    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))

  (body

    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))

    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v))

    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w))
    (call dj_edge_value g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w)
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert
      (== (take p (+ m 1))
          (concat (take p m) (seq-lit (idx p m)))))
    (call dj_path_extend
      g (take p m) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params

  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call dj_vertex_range g start p m)
    (if (== m 0)

        (assert (== (take p 1) (seq-lit start)))
        (if (idx done start)

              (and
                (>= (idx dist (idx p 0)) 0)

                    (path_weight g (take p 1))))))
          (block
            (assert (dj_eligible dist done start))
            (assert (>= (path_weight g (take p 1)) du)))))
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist done u du p (- m 1))
        (call dj_path_step g p m)
        (if (>= (path_weight g (take p m)) du)
          (assert
            (>= (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) du))
          (block
            (assert (idx done (idx p (- m 1))))
            (assert
              (<= (idx dist (idx p (- m 1)))
                  (path_weight g (take p m))))
            (assert
              (has_edge g
                (idx p (- m 1))
                (idx p m)
                (get_edge_weight g
                  (idx p (- m 1))
                  (idx p m))))
            (assert
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0)
                (<= (idx dist (idx p m))
                    (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))))))
            (if (idx done (idx p m))
              (assert
                (and
                  (idx done (idx p m))
                  (and
                    (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0)
                    (<= (idx dist (idx p m))
                        (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))))))
              (block
                (assert (dj_eligible dist done (idx p m)))
                (assert
                  (>= (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) du))))))))))

  (params

(def dj_find_min
  (body
    (let-mut best i64 -1)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len dist))))
      (invariant
        (if (== best -1)
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v i))
                  (and (not (idx done v)) (>= (idx dist v) 0)))
                false))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 best) (< best i))
            (and
              (not (idx done best))
              (and
                (>= (idx dist best) 0)
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=> (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v i))
                        (and
                          (not (idx done v))
                          (>= (idx dist v) 0)))
                      (<= (idx dist best) (idx dist v)))))))))
      (decreases (- (len dist) i))
      (if (and
            (not (idx done i))
            (and
              (>= (idx dist i) 0)
              (or
                (== best -1)
                (< (idx dist i) (idx dist best)))))
        (set best i)
        (block))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (return best)))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (dj_well_formed (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (i) -1)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (j) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (k) (seq-lit start))))
    (let-mut ((next i64))
      (call dj_find_min (borrow dist) (borrow done)))
    (while (!= next -1)
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (dj_dist_range dist))
      (invariant (dj_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (dj_settled (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (dj_closed (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (dj_choice dist done next))
      (decreases (occurrences done false))
      (let u i64 next)
      (let du i64 (idx dist u))
      (call dj_settle_vertex
        (view graph) start dist done wit u)
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (== (len dist) n))
        (invariant (== (len done) n))
        (invariant (== (len wit) n))
        (invariant (== (idx dist u) du))
        (invariant (not (idx done u)))
        (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
        (invariant (dj_dist_range dist))
        (invariant (dj_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
        (invariant (dj_settled (view graph) start dist done))
        (invariant (dj_closed (view graph) dist done))
        (invariant (dj_partial (view graph) dist u i du))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
        (let w i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))
        (assert (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (assert (and (>= w 0) (<= w 100000)))
        (assert (<= du 10000100000))
        (assert (in_i64 (+ du w)))
        (let nd i64 (+ du w))
        (if (idx done v)
          (block
            (call dj_done_edge
              (view graph) start dist done wit u v w)
            (call dj_partial_seen
              (view graph) dist u i du))
          (if (or
                (== (idx dist v) -1)
                (< nd (idx dist v)))
            (block
              (ghost-let dist0 (seq int) dist)
              (ghost-let wit0 (seq (seq int)) wit)
              (ghost-set wit
                (seq-build n
                  (fn (q)
                    (if (== q v)
                      (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))
                      (idx wit0 q)))))
              (set-idx dist v nd)
              (assert (dj_upd dist0 dist v nd))
              (assert
                (dj_updw wit0 wit v
                  (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
              (call dj_witness_step
                (view graph) start
                dist0 wit0 dist wit
                u v w nd)
              (call dj_closed_update
                (view graph) dist0 dist done v nd)
              (call dj_settled_update
                (view graph) start dist0 dist done v nd)
              (call dj_range_update dist0 dist v nd)
              (call dj_partial_update

          (exists ((p (seq int)))
            (and (admissible g start end steps p)
                 (== (path_weight g p) value)))
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=> (admissible g start end steps p)
                (>= (path_weight g p) value))))))))

(ghost-fn round_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (>= steps 0) (== (len distances) (len g)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (and
              (bounded_dist g start v steps (idx distances v))
              (match (idx distances v)
                (case (none) true)
                (case (some value)
                  (and (>= value (neg (* steps 100000)))
                       (<= value (* steps 100000)))))))))))

(ghost-fn initial_dist
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (distances (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len distances) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (== (idx distances v)
                (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))))

(ghost-fn seen_candidate
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
   (v int) (u int) (e int) (x int))
  bool
  (requires (== (len distances) (len g)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (<= u (len g))))
  (requires
    (=> (< u (len g))
        (and (<= 0 e) (<= e (len (idx g u))))))
  (requires (=> (== u (len g)) (== e 0)))
  (body
    (or
      (match (idx distances v)
        (case (none) false)
        (case (some old_value) (== x old_value)))
      (exists ((a int) (b int) (source_value int))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx g a))))
              (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< b e)))))
          (and
            (== (idx distances a) (some source_value))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) b) 0) v)
              (== x
                  (+ source_value
                     (get (idx (idx g a) b) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn cursor_choice
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
   (v int) (u int) (e int) (best (option int)))
  bool
  (requires (== (len distances) (len g)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (<= u (len g))))
  (requires
    (=> (< u (len g))
        (and (<= 0 e) (<= e (len (idx g u))))))
  (requires (=> (== u (len g)) (== e 0)))
  (body
    (match best
      (case (none)
        (forall ((x int))
          (not (seen_candidate g distances v u e x))))
      (case (some value)
        (and
          (seen_candidate g distances v u e value)
          (forall ((x int))
            (=> (seen_candidate g distances v u e x)
                (<= value x))))))))

(ghost-fn step_value
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
   (v int) (u int) (e int) (before (option int)) (after (option int)))
  bool
  (requires (== (len distances) (len g)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
  (body
    (==
      after
      (if (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v)
        (match (idx distances u)
          (case (none) before)
          (case (some source_value)
            (match before
              (case (none)
                (some
                  (+ source_value
                     (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))))
              (case (some current_value)
                (if
                  (< (+ source_value
                        (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))
                     current_value)
                  (some
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
                  before)))))
        before))))

(ghost-fn prefix_round
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
   (next (seq (option int))) (count int))
  bool
  (requires (== (len distances) (len g)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 count) (<= count (len g))))
  (body
    (and
      (== (len next) count)
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v count))
            (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0
              (idx next v)))))))

(ghost-fn round_track
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int)))
   (next (seq (option int))) (count int) (changed bool))
  bool
  (requires (== (len distances) (len g)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 count) (<= count (len g))))
  (body
    (and
      (prefix_round g distances next count)
      (if changed
        (exists ((v int))
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v count))
               (!= (idx next v) (idx distances v))))
        (forall ((v int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v count))
              (== (idx next v) (idx distances v))))))))

(ghost-fn fixed_dist
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (distances (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len distances) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0
              (idx distances v)))))))

(ghost-fn solution
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (distances (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len distances) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (match (idx distances v)
              (case (none)
                (forall ((p (seq int)))
                  (=> (and
                        (is_path g p)
                        (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                             (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                      false)))
              (case (some value)
                (is_shortest_dist g start v value))))))))

(ghost-fn cycle_part ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p))))
  (body
    (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))

(ghost-fn cut_cycle ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p))))
  (body
    (concat (take p i) (drop p j))))

(lemma bounded_edge_at
  (params

  (params

  (requires

    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (round_track g distances before v changed_before)
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 best)
    (== changed_here (!= best (idx distances v)))
    (== changed_after (or changed_before changed_here))
    (== after (concat before (seq-lit best))))
  (ensures

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
      (and
        (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
        (and
          (connected g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
               (get_edge_weight g
                 (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))
  (body))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (weight_from
        (idx g u)
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
        j)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i j))
  (body
    (if (< j i)
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (call weight_from_index g u i (+ j 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma edge_weight_lookup
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires

    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (call weight_from_index g u i 0)))

(lemma append_edge_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
    (start int) (u int) (v int) (edge_index int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 edge_index) (< edge_index (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 0) v))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (and
        (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
        (and
          (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                   (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
              v)
          (and
            (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
            (==
              (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
              (+ (path_weight g p)
                 (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 1))))))))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_lookup g u edge_index)))

(lemma candidate_realizes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p)
        (== (path_weight g p) x))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start v steps (idx distances v)))
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start v steps old_path)
            (== (path_weight g old_path) x)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) old_path)))
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 edge_index)
                     (< edge_index (len (idx g source))))
                (or (< source (len g))
                    (and (== source (len g))
                         (< edge_index 0)))))
            (and
              (== (idx distances source) (some source_value))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 0) v)
                (== x
                    (+ source_value
                       (get (idx (idx g source) edge_index) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bounded_dist g start source steps
            (idx distances source)))
        (obtain ((source_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (admissible g start source steps source_path)
            (== (path_weight g source_path) source_value)))
        (call append_edge_path
          g source_path start source v edge_index)
        (assert
          (admissible g start v (+ steps 1)
            (concat source_path (seq-lit v)))))))))

(lemma path_has_candidate
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures
    (exists ((x int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x)
        (<= x (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if (<= (- (len p) 1) steps)
      (match (idx distances v)
        (case (none)
          (assert false))
        (case (some old_value)
          (block
            (assert
              (bounded_dist g start v steps
                (idx distances v)))
            (assert
              (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 old_value)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let prefix_path (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let previous int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert
          (admissible g start previous steps prefix_path))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge g previous v edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 previous) (< previous (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g previous)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g previous) edge_index) 1)
                  edge_weight))))
        (call edge_weight_lookup g previous edge_index)
        (match (idx distances previous)
          (case (none)
            (assert false))
          (case (some previous_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (bounded_dist g start previous steps
                  (idx distances previous)))
              (assert
                (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0
                  (+ previous_value edge_weight)))))))))

(lemma choice_none_excludes_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)

    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (none))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_has_candidate
      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma choice_some_lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (chosen int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (cursor_choice g distances v (len g) 0 (some chosen))
    (admissible g start v (+ steps 1) p))

      g start distances steps v p)
    (obtain ((candidate_value int))
      (and
        (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 candidate_value)
        (<= candidate_value (path_weight g p))))))

(lemma candidate_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (distances (seq (option int))) (steps int)
    (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (bounded_edges g)
    (round_ok g start distances steps)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (seen_candidate g distances v (len g) 0 x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (>= x (neg (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
      (<= x (* (+ steps 1) 100000))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx distances v) (some x))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain
          ((source int) (edge_index int) (source_value int))
          (and
            (and
