                  (== (idx dist start) 0)
                  (and
                    (forall ((v int))
                      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                          (and (<= 0 (idx dist v))
                               (<= (idx dist v) (dj_inf)))))
                    (and
                      (forall ((v int))
                        (=> (and
                              (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                              (< (idx dist v) (dj_inf)))
                            (dj_witness g start v (idx dist v))))
                      (and
                        (forall ((v int))
                          (=> (and
                                (and
                                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                                  (== (idx used v) 1))
                                (< (idx dist v) (dj_inf)))
                              (is_shortest_dist
                                g start v (idx dist v))))
                        (and
                          (dj_closed g dist used)
                          (dj_ordered dist used))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_minimum
  ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq int)) (u int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len used))
      (and
        (dj_bits used)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
          (and
            (== (idx used u) 0)
            (forall ((v int))
              (=> (and
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
                    (== (idx used v) 0))
                  (<= (idx dist u) (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_scan
  ((dist (seq int))
   (used (seq int))
   (limit int)
   (found bool)
   (choice int)
   (best int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len used))
      (and
        (dj_bits used)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len dist)))
          (if found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 choice) (< choice limit))
              (and
                (== (idx used choice) 0)
                (and
                  (== best (idx dist choice))
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=> (and
                          (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                          (== (idx used v) 0))
                        (<= best (idx dist v)))))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                  (== (idx used v) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_one_update
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len after) (len before))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
        (and
          (== (idx after at) value)
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                  (!= v at))
                (== (idx after v) (idx before v)))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_used_update
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (dj_bits before)
      (and
        (== (len after) (len before))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
          (and
            (== (idx after at) 1)
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=> (and
                      (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                      (!= v at))
                    (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))
              (and
                (dj_bits after)
                (==
                  (occurrences after 1)
                  (+ (occurrences before 1)
                     (if (== (idx before at) 1) 0 1)))))))))))

(lemma dj_occ_le_len
  (params (s (seq int)) (x int))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (occurrences s x))
      (<= (occurrences s x) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len (take s (- (len s) 1)) x)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          x))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s x)))))

(lemma dj_one_missing
  (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (!= (idx s v) 1))
  (ensures
    (< (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (< v (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_idx_take s (- (len s) 1) v)
        (call dj_one_missing
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          v)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (assert (== v (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_occ_le_len
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          1)
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1)))))

(lemma dj_one_from_full
  (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx s v) 1))
  (body
    (if (== (idx s v) 1)
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_one_missing s v)
        (assert false)))))

(lemma dj_all_count
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
          (== (idx s v) 1))))
  (ensures
    (== (occurrences s 1) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (call dj_all_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          1)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1))
          1))
      (block
        (call law_take_none s)
        (call law_occurrences_none s 1)))))

(lemma dj_weight_from_at
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_from_at row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_from_at (idx g u) v w 0 j)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      g
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_path_vertex_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_path_vertex_range g p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (assert
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                   (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  1)
                w))))
        (assert
          (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
               (< (idx p k) (len g))))))))

(lemma dj_append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (assert
        (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (connected g u v))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call dj_append_connection g p u v w i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_single_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start start 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (dj_witness g start start 0))))

(lemma dj_path_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (dj_witness g start u d)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start u d))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (call dj_append_path g p start u v w)
    (assert (dj_witness g start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma dj_shortest_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (v int)
    (d int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (is_shortest_dist g start v d)
    (dj_witness g start v candidate))
  (ensures
    (<= d candidate))
  (body
    (assert (dj_witness g start v candidate))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (== (path_weight g p) candidate)))
    (assert (>= (path_weight g p) d))))

(lemma dj_row_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (u int)
    (k int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_closed g dist u k du)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))
    (=>
      (< du (dj_inf))
      (and
        (< (idx dist v) (dj_inf))
        (<= (idx dist v) (+ du w)))))
  (ensures
    (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))
  (body
    (assert (dj_row_closed g dist u (+ k 1) du))))

(lemma dj_level_raise
  (params (dist (seq int)) (count int))

  (body))

(lemma dj_level_update
  (params
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (at int)
    (value int)
    (limit int))
  (requires
    (dj_level before limit)
    (dj_one_update before after at value)
    (< value (dj_inf))
    (<= value (* limit 100000)))

  (body))

(lemma dj_initialize
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_valid g)
    (dj_unique g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (or
            (and (== v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) 0))
            (and (!= v start)
                 (== (idx dist v) (dj_inf))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx used v) 0))))
  (ensures
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (dj_level dist 0))
  (body
    (assert (dj_bits used))
    (assert (dj_ordered dist used))
    (assert (dj_level dist 0))
    (call dj_single_path g start)))

(lemma dj_scan_next
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len dist)))
    (dj_scan dist used i found choice best))
  (ensures
    (dj_scan
      dist
      used
      (+ i 1)
      (or
        found
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best))))
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        i
        choice)
      (if
        (and
          (== (idx used i) 0)
          (or (not found) (< (idx dist i) best)))
        (idx dist i)
        best)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (found bool)
    (choice int)
    (best int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (dj_scan dist used (len dist) found choice best)
    (== (occurrences used 1) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len used))))
  (ensures
    found
    (== best (idx dist choice))
    (dj_minimum dist used choice))
  (body
    (if found
      (block)
      (block
        (call dj_all_count used)
        (assert false)))
    (assert found)
    (assert (== best (idx dist choice)))
    (assert (dj_minimum dist used choice))))

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
      (<=
        (idx dist (idx p k))
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call dj_path_vertex_range g p k)
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dj_path_vertex_range g p (- k 1))
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step p k)
        (call dj_append_path
          g
          (take p k)
          start
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (idx p k)
          w)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (+
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              w)))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))))))

(lemma dj_first_unsettled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
          (== (idx used (idx p j)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call dj_path_vertex_range g p k)
    (if (== (idx used (idx p k)) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_prefix_bound
          g start dist used p k)
        (call dj_path_prefix g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist u)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight g p)
            (idx dist u))))
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (call dj_first_unsettled
          g start dist used u p (+ k 1))
        (block
          (assert (== k (- (len p) 1)))
          (assert (== (idx p k) u))
          (assert false))))))

(lemma dj_pick_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq int))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_base g start dist used)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dj_minimum dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (call dj_first_unsettled
      g start dist used u p 0)))

(lemma dj_pick
  (params

(lemma dj_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires
    (dj_unique g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))

    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k))

      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (ghost-let shorter (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (is_path g shorter))
        (call dj_path_prefix g shorter k)
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert (>= w 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g p)
            (+ (path_weight g shorter) w)))
        (call law_take_take
          p
          (- (len p) 1)
          (+ k 1))
        (assert
          (<=
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
            (path_weight g p)))))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma dj_prefix_bound

    (and
      (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))

        (idx dist (idx p k))

  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call dj_path_vertex_range g p k)

      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block

          g start dist used p (- k 1))

            g

            (idx p (- k 1))

        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))

              (path_weight g (take p k))

        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p k)) (dj_inf))
            (<=
              (idx dist (idx p k))
              (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (dj_valid (view graph)))
    (assert (dj_unique (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (bd) 10000000001)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut used (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (bu) 0)))
    (call dj_initialize
      (view graph) start dist used)
    (let-mut count i64 0)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (== (occurrences used 1) count))
      (invariant
        (dj_base (view graph) start dist used))
      (invariant (dj_level dist count))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut choice i64 0)
      (let-mut best i64 10000000001)
      (while (< scan_i n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i n)))
        (invariant
          (dj_scan
            dist used scan_i found choice best))
        (decreases (- n scan_i))
        (call dj_scan_next
          dist used scan_i found choice best)
        (if
          (and
            (== (idx used scan_i) 0)
            (or
              (not found)

  (requires (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len g))))
  (decreases upto)
  (body
    (if (== upto 0)
      cur
      (bf_relax_from
        old
        (bf_rows g old cur (- upto 1) inf)
        (idx g (- upto 1))
        (- upto 1)
        (len (idx g (- upto 1)))
        inf))))

(ghost-fn bf_round
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (old (seq int)) (inf int))
  (seq int)
  (body (bf_rows g old old (len g) inf)))

(ghost-fn bf_iter
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (inf int) (k int))
  (seq int)
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (bf_init (len g) start inf)
      (bf_round g (bf_iter g start inf (- k 1)) inf))))

(ghost-fn bf_changed
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (changed bool)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len after))
      (and
        (forall ((v int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
              (<= (idx after v) (idx before v))))
        (if changed
          (exists ((v int))
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
                 (< (idx after v) (idx before v))))
          (== after before))))))

(ghost-fn bf_answers
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (d (seq int)) (inf int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len d) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (if (== (idx d v) inf)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and (is_path g p)
                         (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false))
              (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx d v))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_formatted
  ((d (seq int)) (out (seq (option int))) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len out) (len d))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
            (== (idx out v)
                (if (== (idx d v) inf)
                  (none)
                  (some (idx d v)))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_pointwise_le ((a (seq int)) (b (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len a) (len b))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a)))
            (<= (idx a v) (idx b v)))))))

(ghost-fn bf_closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len d) (len g))
      (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
        (=> (and (has_edge g u v w)
                 (!= (idx d u) inf))
            (and (!= (idx d v) inf)
                 (<= (idx d v) (+ (idx d u) w))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_witnessed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (d (seq int)) (inf int) (k int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len d) (len g))
      (and
        (and (!= (idx d start) inf)
             (<= (idx d start) 0))
        (forall ((v int))
          (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
                   (!= (idx d v) inf))
              (exists ((p (seq int)))
                (and
                  (and (is_path g p)
                       (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  (and (== (path_weight g p) (idx d v))
                       (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_limited
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (d (seq int)) (inf int) (k int))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (=> (and
            (and (is_path g p)
                 (== (idx p 0) start))
            (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))
          (and
            (!= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) inf)
            (<= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))
                (path_weight g p)))))))

(ghost-fn bf_vertices_in
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
          (and (<= 0 (idx p i))
               (< (idx p i) (len g)))))))

(ghost-fn bf_distinct ((p (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
            (< j (len p)))
          (!= (idx p i) (idx p j))))))

(lemma bf_view_ok
  (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (bf_graph_ok (view wg)))
  (body))

(lemma bf_copy
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (ensures
    (== (seq-build (len s) (fn (j) (idx s j))) s))
  (body
    (call law_seq_ext
      (seq-build (len s) (fn (j) (idx s j)))
      s)))

(lemma bf_bound_widen
  (params (s (seq int)) (inf int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (bf_bounded s inf a) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a b)))
  (ensures (bf_bounded s inf b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_update_point
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (source int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (inf int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur)))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len cur)))
    (!= (idx old source) inf)
    (< (+ (idx old source) w) (idx cur v))
    (== after (seq_update cur v (+ (idx old source) w))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx after j)
        (idx (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf) j)))
  (body
    (if (== j v)
      (call law_update_at cur v (+ (idx old source) w))
      (call law_update_other cur v (+ (idx old source) w) j))))

(lemma bf_update_step
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (source int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur)))
    (!= (idx old source) inf)
    (< (+ (idx old source) w) (idx cur v))
    (== after (seq_update cur v (+ (idx old source) w))))
  (ensures
    (== after (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf)))
  (body
    (forall ((j int))
      (call bf_update_point old cur after source v w inf j))
    (call law_seq_ext after (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf))))

(lemma bf_no_update_point
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (source int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (inf int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur)))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len cur)))
    (or (== (idx old source) inf)
        (>= (+ (idx old source) w) (idx cur v))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx cur j)
        (idx (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf) j)))
  (body))

(lemma bf_no_update_step
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (source int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur)))
    (or (== (idx old source) inf)
        (>= (+ (idx old source) w) (idx cur v))))
  (ensures
    (== cur (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf)))
  (body
    (forall ((j int))
      (call bf_no_update_point old cur source v w inf j))
    (call law_seq_ext cur (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf))))

(lemma bf_changed_update
  (params
    (base (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (flag bool)
    (v int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (bf_changed base cur flag)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur)))
    (< x (idx cur v))
    (== after (seq_update cur v x)))
  (ensures (bf_changed base after true))
  (body))

(lemma bf_bound_update
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (source int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (inf int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (bf_bounded old inf bound)
    (bf_bounded cur inf (+ bound 100000))
    (== (len old) (len cur))
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur)))
    (!= (idx old source) inf)
    (and (>= w -100000) (<= w 100000))
    (< (+ (idx old source) w) (idx cur v))
    (== after (seq_update cur v (+ (idx old source) w))))
  (ensures (bf_bounded after inf (+ bound 100000)))
  (body))

(lemma bf_set_point
  (params
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (v int)
    (x int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (== (idx after v) x)
    (forall ((q int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len before)))
            (!= q v))
          (== (idx after q) (idx before q))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len before))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx after j)
        (idx (seq_update before v x) j)))
  (body
    (if (== j v)
      (call law_update_at before v x)
      (call law_update_other before v x j))))

(lemma bf_set_exact
  (params
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (v int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (== (idx after v) x)
    (forall ((q int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len before)))
            (!= q v))
          (== (idx after q) (idx before q)))))
  (ensures
    (== after (seq_update before v x)))
  (body
    (forall ((j int))
      (call bf_set_point before after v x j))
    (call law_seq_ext after (seq_update before v x))))

(lemma bf_edge_step_facts
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (source int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (== (len old) (len cur))
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len cur))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf)) (len cur))
    (bf_pointwise_le (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf) cur)
    (=> (!= (idx old source) inf)
        (<= (idx (bf_edge_step old cur source v w inf) v)
            (+ (idx old source) w))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_relax_facts
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (source int)
    (upto int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (== (len old) (len cur))
    (and (<= 0 source) (< source (len old)))
    (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len row)))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
          (and
            (<= 0 (get (idx row i) 0))
            (< (get (idx row i) 0) (len cur))))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (bf_relax_from old cur row source upto inf))
        (len cur))
    (bf_pointwise_le
      (bf_relax_from old cur row source upto inf)
      cur)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
               (!= (idx old source) inf))
          (<=
            (idx
              (bf_relax_from old cur row source upto inf)
              (get (idx row i) 0))
            (+ (idx old source)
               (get (idx row i) 1))))))
  (decreases upto)
  (body
    (if (> upto 0)
      (block
        (call bf_relax_facts
          old cur row source (- upto 1) inf)
        (call bf_edge_step_facts
          old
          (bf_relax_from old cur row source (- upto 1) inf)
          source
          (get (idx row (- upto 1)) 0)
          (get (idx row (- upto 1)) 1)
          inf))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_rows_facts
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (cur (seq int))
    (upto int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (== (len old) (len g))
    (== (len cur) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (bf_rows g old cur upto inf)) (len g))
    (bf_pointwise_le (bf_rows g old cur upto inf) cur)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u upto))
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                 (!= (idx old u) inf)))
          (<=
            (idx
              (bf_rows g old cur upto inf)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (+ (idx old u)
               (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (decreases upto)
  (body
    (if (> upto 0)
      (block
        (call bf_rows_facts
          g old cur (- upto 1) inf)
        (call bf_relax_facts
          old
          (bf_rows g old cur (- upto 1) inf)
          (idx g (- upto 1))
          (- upto 1)
          (len (idx g (- upto 1)))
          inf))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_round_facts
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (== (len old) (len g)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (bf_round g old inf)) (len g))
    (bf_pointwise_le (bf_round g old inf) old)
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=> (and (has_edge g u v w)
               (!= (idx old u) inf))
          (<= (idx (bf_round g old inf) v)
              (+ (idx old u) w)))))
  (body
    (call bf_rows_facts g old old (len g) inf)))

(lemma bf_weight_hit_from
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (hit int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i hit))
    (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row hit) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row hit) 1) w)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
            (!= j hit))
          (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- hit i))
  (body
    (if (< i hit)
      (call bf_weight_hit_from row v w hit (+ i 1))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_edge_lookup
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph g))
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call bf_weight_hit_from
      (idx g u) v w i 0)))

(lemma bf_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (connected g
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (take p (- (len p) 1))
          (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g
             (idx p (- (len p) 2))
             (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_closed_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bf_closed (view wg) d inf)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d)))
    (!= (idx d start) inf)
    (<= (idx d start) 0)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) inf)
    (<= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (path_weight (view wg) p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (> (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call bf_closed_path
          wg start d inf
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call bf_edge_lookup
          (view wg)
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_fixed_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (k int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bf_witnessed (view wg) start d inf k)
    (bf_closed (view wg) d inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))))
  (ensures
    (if (== (idx d v) inf)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=> (and
              (is_path (view wg) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false))
      (is_shortest_dist
        (view wg) start v (idx d v))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx d v) inf)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call bf_closed_path wg start d inf p))
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path (view wg) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (and
              (== (path_weight (view wg) p) (idx d v))
              (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))))
        (forall ((q (seq int)))
          (call bf_closed_path wg start d inf q))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_answers_from
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bf_witnessed (view wg) start d inf k)
    (bf_closed (view wg) d inf))
  (ensures
    (bf_answers (view wg) start d inf))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_fixed_vertex wg start d inf k v))))

(lemma bf_round_closed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (== (len d) (len g))
    (== (bf_round g d inf) d))
  (ensures
    (bf_closed g d inf))
  (body
    (call bf_round_facts g d inf)))

(lemma bf_init_semantics
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures
    (bf_witnessed g start
      (bf_init (len g) start inf) inf 0)
    (bf_limited g start
      (bf_init (len g) start inf) inf 0)
    (bf_bounded
      (bf_init (len g) start inf) inf 0))
  (body))

(lemma bf_round_witnessed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_witnessed g start old inf k)
    (bf_bounded old inf (* k 100000))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
    (> inf 10000000000))
  (ensures
    (bf_witnessed g start
      (bf_round g old inf) inf (+ k 1))
    (bf_bounded
      (bf_round g old inf) inf (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
  (body))

(lemma bf_limited_step_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (k int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len old)))
    (bf_limited (view wg) start old inf k)
    (bf_pointwise_le after old)
    (== (len after) (len old))
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=> (and
            (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
            (!= (idx old u) inf))
          (<= (idx after v)
              (+ (idx old u) w))))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (<= (len p) (+ k 2)))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx after (idx p (- (len p) 1))) inf)
    (<= (idx after (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (path_weight (view wg) p)))
  (body
    (if (> (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call bf_edge_lookup
          (view wg)
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_round_limited
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bf_graph_ok (view wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len old)))
    (== (len old) (len (view wg)))
    (bf_limited (view wg) start old inf k))
  (ensures
    (bf_limited
      (view wg) start
      (bf_round (view wg) old inf)
      inf
      (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (call bf_round_facts (view wg) old inf)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call bf_limited_step_path
        wg start old
        (bf_round (view wg) old inf)
        inf k p))))

(lemma bf_iter_semantics
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (inf int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (size wg)))
    (> inf 10000000000))
  (ensures
    (== (len (bf_iter (view wg) start inf k))
        (size wg))
    (bf_witnessed
      (view wg) start
      (bf_iter (view wg) start inf k)
      inf k)
    (bf_limited

      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (count_true s k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_true_false s (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_true_update
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (at int)

  (requires
    (updb before after at true)
    (not (idx before at))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len before))))
  (ensures

      (count_true after k)
      (+ (count_true before k) (if (< at k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_true_update before after at (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_true_full
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires

    (== (count_true s k) k))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (idx s i))))
  (decreases k)
  (body

      (block

(lemma weight_from_hit
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (hit int)

      (and
        (< hit (len row))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row hit) 0) v)
          (and
            (== (get (idx row hit) 1) w)
            (forall ((i int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
                  (!= i hit))
                (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))))))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v from) w))
  (decreases (- hit from))
  (body
    (if (< from hit)
      (call weight_from_hit row v w hit (+ from 1))
      (block))))

(lemma edge_value
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))

  (body
    (obtain ((hit int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) hit) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) hit) 1) w))))
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (view wg) u))))
            (!= i hit))
          (!= (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0) v))))
    (call weight_from_hit (idx (view wg) u) v w hit 0)))

(lemma prefix_edge
  (params

        (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)

(lemma path_weight_step
  (params

  (requires

    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)

  (params

(lemma append_weight
  (params

(lemma witness_update_point
  (params

      (concat (idx wit_before u) (seq-lit v)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len before)))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ (idx before u) w))
    (!= u v))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len after))) (>= (idx after k) 0))
      (and
        (is_path (view wg) (idx wit_after k))

          (and
            (== (idx (idx wit_after k) (- (len (idx wit_after k)) 1)) k)
            (== (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit_after k)) (idx after k)))))))
  (body
    (if

        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len after)))

        (block

          (assert (> (len (idx wit_before u)) 0))
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx wit_before u) 0) start))
          (assert
            (==
              (idx
                (idx wit_before u)
                (- (len (idx wit_before u)) 1))
              u))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit_before u))
              (idx before u)))
          (call append_path
            (view wg)
            (idx wit_before u)
            v
            w)
          (call append_weight
            wg
            (idx wit_before u)
            v
            w))
        (block))
      (block))))

(lemma walk_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (idx dist (idx p k)))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        best)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (call law_idx_take p 1 0)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start)))
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_bound
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1) candidate best)
        (call path_weight_step wg p k w)))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
           (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (block
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            (idx p k)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
            (idx dist (idx p k)))))
      (if
        (== k 0)
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            best))
        (block
          (obtain ((step_w int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              step_w))
          (assert (>= step_w 0))
          (if
            (idx seen (idx p (- k 1)))
            (block
              (assert
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (idx p k))
                    (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) step_w))))
              (assert (<= best (idx dist (idx p k)))))
            (block))
          (assert
            (>=
              (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
              best)))))))

(lemma select_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 candidate) (< candidate (len dist)))
      (and
        (not (idx seen candidate))
        (and
          (== best (idx dist candidate))
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            candidate
            best)))))
  (body
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 candidate) (< candidate (len dist))))
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (idx wit candidate)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (idx wit candidate) 0) start))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx wit candidate) (- (len (idx wit candidate)) 1))
        candidate))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit candidate))
        best))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call walk_bound
        wg
        start
        dist
        seen
        p
        (- (len p) 1)
        candidate
        best))))

(lemma walk_seen
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)

    (== (idx dist start) 0)

    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures (idx seen (idx p k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (> k 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_seen
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1))
        (if
          (idx seen (idx p k))
          (block)
          (block
            (assert
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                (<=
                  (idx dist (idx p k))
                  (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) w))))
            (assert false))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (if
          (idx seen (idx p k))
          (block)
          (assert false))))))

(lemma no_candidate_vertex
  (params

    (start int)

  (requires

    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) -1 -1))
  (ensures
    (match
      (if (== (idx dist v) -1)

        (some (idx dist v)))
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))

            (and

    (if

  (params

    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))

      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))

      (seq-lit v)

(lemma walk_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (idx dist (idx p k)))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        best)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (call law_idx_take p 1 0)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start)))
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_bound
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1) candidate best)
        (call path_weight_step wg p k w)))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
           (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (block
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            (idx p k)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
            (idx dist (idx p k)))))
      (if
        (== k 0)
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            best))
        (block
          (obtain ((step_w int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              step_w))
          (assert (>= step_w 0))
          (if
            (idx seen (idx p (- k 1)))
            (block
              (assert
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (idx p k))
                    (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) step_w))))
              (assert (<= best (idx dist (idx p k)))))
            (block))
          (assert
            (>=
              (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
              best)))))))

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (n int)
    (round int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (wit_before (seq (seq int)))
    (wit_after (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (== n (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 round) (< round n))
    (dist_range before n (+ round 1))
    (seen_range seen before n)
    (witnesses (view wg) start before wit_before)
    (finalized (view wg) start before seen)
    (closed_except wg before seen u i)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (idx seen u)
    (== (idx before start) 0)
    (<= (idx before u) (* round 100000))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (not (idx seen v))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (== x (+ (idx before u) w))
    (or (== (idx before v) -1) (< x (idx before v)))
    (upd before after v x)
    (updw
      wit_before
      wit_after
      v
      (concat (idx wit_before u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures
    (dist_range after n (+ round 1))
    (seen_range seen after n)
    (witnesses (view wg) start after wit_after)
    (finalized (view wg) start after seen)
    (closed_except wg after seen u (+ i 1))
    (== (idx after start) (idx before start))
    (== (idx after u) (idx before u)))
  (body
    (call edge_value wg u v w)
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (>= x 0))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert (<= x (* (+ round 1) 100000)))
    (call witness_update
      wg start before after wit_before wit_after u v w x)))

(spec dijkstra_candidate_step
  (params
    (dist (ref (slice i64)))
    (seen (ref (slice bool)))
    (upto i64)
    (candidate i64)
    (best i64))
  (returns (next_candidate i64) (next_best i64))
  (requires
    (candidate_prefix dist seen upto candidate best)
    (< upto (len dist)))
  (ensures
    (candidate_prefix
      dist
      seen
      (+ upto 1)
      next_candidate
      next_best))
  (effects))

(def dijkstra_candidate_step
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (not (idx seen upto))
        (>= (idx dist upto) 0))
      (if
        (or
          (== candidate -1)
          (< (idx dist upto) best))
        (return upto (idx dist upto))
        (return candidate best))
      (return candidate best))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (init_i) -1)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut seen (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (seen_i) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (wit_i) (seq-lit start))))
    (call initial_state graph start dist seen wit)
    (let-mut round i64 0)
    (while (< round n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 round) (<= round n)))
      (invariant (dist_range dist n round))
      (invariant (seen_range seen dist n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (finalized (view graph) start dist seen))
      (invariant (closed (view graph) dist seen))
      (invariant (== (count_true seen n) round))
      (decreases (- n round))
      (let-mut candidate i64 -1)
      (let-mut best i64 -1)
      (let-mut scan i64 0)
      (while (< scan n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 scan) (<= scan n)))
        (invariant
          (candidate_prefix dist seen scan candidate best))
        (decreases (- n scan))
        (let
          ((next_candidate i64) (next_best i64))
          (call dijkstra_candidate_step
            (borrow dist)
            (borrow seen)
            scan
            candidate
            best))
        (set candidate next_candidate)
        (set best next_best)
        (set scan (+ scan 1)))
      (if
        (== candidate -1)
        (block
          (forall ((v int))
            (call no_candidate_vertex
              graph start dist seen round v))
          (return
            (seq-build n
              (fn (result_i)
                (if
                  (== (idx dist result_i) -1)
                  (none)
                  (some (idx dist result_i)))))))
        (block
          (call select_shortest
            graph
            start
            dist
            seen
            wit
            candidate
            best)
          (assert (<= best (* round 100000)))
          (ghost-let seen_before (seq bool) seen)
          (set-idx seen candidate true)
          (assert (updb seen_before seen candidate true))
          (call count_true_update
            seen_before seen candidate n)
          (call mark_state
            graph
            start
            dist
            seen_before
            seen
            candidate)
          (call range_weaken dist n round)
          (let degree i64
            (len (idx (field graph adj) candidate)))
          (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
          (while (< edge_i degree)
            (invariant
              (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i degree)))
            (invariant (dist_range dist n (+ round 1)))
            (invariant (seen_range seen dist n))
            (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
            (invariant (== (idx dist candidate) best))
            (invariant (<= best (* round 100000)))
            (invariant (idx seen candidate))
            (invariant
              (witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
            (invariant
              (finalized (view graph) start dist seen))
            (invariant
              (closed_except
                graph dist seen candidate edge_i))
            (invariant
              (== (count_true seen n) (+ round 1)))
            (decreases (- degree edge_i))
            (let edge (tuple i64 i64)
              (idx
                (idx (field graph adj) candidate)
                edge_i))
            (let target i64 (get edge 0))
            (let weight i64 (get edge 1))
            (assert
              (has_edge
                (view graph)
                candidate
                target
                weight))
            (call edge_value graph candidate target weight)
            (assert
              (and (>= weight 0) (<= weight 100000)))
            (if
              (not (idx seen target))
              (if
                (or
                  (== (idx dist target) -1)
                  (< (+ best weight) (idx dist target)))
                (block
                  (ghost-let dist_before (seq int) dist)
                  (ghost-let wit_before (seq (seq int)) wit)
                  (ghost-set wit
                    (seq-build n
                      (fn (wit_j)
                        (if
                          (== wit_j target)
                          (concat
                            (idx wit_before candidate)
                            (seq-lit target))
                          (idx wit_before wit_j)))))
                  (set-idx dist target (+ best weight))
                  (assert
                    (upd
                      dist_before
                      dist
                      target
                      (+ best weight)))
                  (assert
                    (updw
                      wit_before
                      wit
                      target
                      (concat
                        (idx wit_before candidate)
                        (seq-lit target))))
                  (call relax_update
                    graph
                    start
                    n
                    round
                    dist_before

    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))

  (params

      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))

(lemma walk_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (idx dist (idx p k)))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        best)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (call law_idx_take p 1 0)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start)))
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_bound
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1) candidate best)
        (call path_weight_step wg p k w)))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
           (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (block
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            (idx p k)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
            (idx dist (idx p k)))))
      (if
        (== k 0)
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            best))
        (block
          (obtain ((step_w int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              step_w))
          (assert (>= step_w 0))
          (if
            (idx seen (idx p (- k 1)))
            (block
              (assert
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (idx p k))
                    (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) step_w))))
              (assert (<= best (idx dist (idx p k)))))
            (block))
          (assert
            (>=
              (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
              best)))))))

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (n int)
    (round int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (wit_before (seq (seq int)))

  (requires

    (seen_range seen before n)
    (witnesses (view wg) start before wit_before)
    (finalized (view wg) start before seen)
    (closed_except wg before seen u i)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (idx seen u)
    (== (idx before start) 0)
    (<= (idx before u) (* round 100000))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (not (idx seen v))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (== x (+ (idx before u) w))
    (or (== (idx before v) -1) (< x (idx before v)))
    (upd before after v x)
    (updw
      wit_before
      wit_after
      v
      (concat (idx wit_before u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures
    (dist_range after n (+ round 1))
    (seen_range seen after n)
    (witnesses (view wg) start after wit_after)
    (finalized (view wg) start after seen)
    (closed_except wg after seen u (+ i 1))
    (== (idx after start) (idx before start))
    (== (idx after u) (idx before u)))
  (body
    (call edge_value wg u v w)
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (>= x 0))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert (<= x (* (+ round 1) 100000)))
    (call witness_update

(spec dijkstra_candidate_step
  (params
    (dist (ref (slice i64)))
    (seen (ref (slice bool)))
    (upto i64)
    (candidate i64)
    (best i64))
  (returns (next_candidate i64) (next_best i64))
  (requires
    (candidate_prefix dist seen upto candidate best)
    (< upto (len dist)))
  (ensures
    (candidate_prefix
      dist
      seen
      (+ upto 1)
      next_candidate
      next_best))
  (effects))

(def dijkstra_candidate_step
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (not (idx seen upto))
        (>= (idx dist upto) 0))
      (if
        (or
          (== candidate -1)
          (< (idx dist upto) best))
        (return upto (idx dist upto))
        (return candidate best))
      (return candidate best))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (init_i) -1)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut seen (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (seen_i) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (wit_i) (seq-lit start))))
    (call initial_state graph start dist seen wit)
    (let-mut round i64 0)
    (while (< round n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 round) (<= round n)))
      (invariant (dist_range dist n round))
      (invariant (seen_range seen dist n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (finalized (view graph) start dist seen))
      (invariant (closed (view graph) dist seen))
      (invariant (== (count_true seen n) round))
      (decreases (- n round))
      (let-mut candidate i64 -1)
      (let-mut best i64 -1)
      (let-mut scan i64 0)
      (while (< scan n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 scan) (<= scan n)))
        (invariant
          (candidate_prefix dist seen scan candidate best))
        (decreases (- n scan))
        (let
          ((next_candidate i64) (next_best i64))
          (call dijkstra_candidate_step
            (borrow dist)
            (borrow seen)
            scan
            candidate
            best))
        (set candidate next_candidate)
        (set best next_best)
        (set scan (+ scan 1)))
      (if
        (== candidate -1)
        (block
          (forall ((v int))
            (call no_candidate_vertex
              graph start dist seen round v))
          (return
            (seq-build n
              (fn (result_i)
                (if
                  (== (idx dist result_i) -1)
                  (none)
                  (some (idx dist result_i)))))))
        (block
          (call select_shortest
            graph
            start
            dist
            seen
            wit
            candidate
            best)
          (assert (<= best (* round 100000)))
          (ghost-let seen_before (seq bool) seen)
          (set-idx seen candidate true)
          (assert (updb seen_before seen candidate true))
          (call count_true_update
            seen_before seen candidate n)
          (call mark_state
            graph
            start
            dist
            seen_before
            seen
            candidate)
          (call range_weaken dist n round)
          (let degree i64
            (len (idx (field graph adj) candidate)))
          (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
          (while (< edge_i degree)
            (invariant
              (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i degree)))
            (invariant (dist_range dist n (+ round 1)))
            (invariant (seen_range seen dist n))
            (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
            (invariant (== (idx dist candidate) best))
            (invariant (<= best (* round 100000)))
            (invariant (idx seen candidate))
            (invariant
              (witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
            (invariant
              (finalized (view graph) start dist seen))
            (invariant
              (closed_except
                graph dist seen candidate edge_i))
            (invariant
              (== (count_true seen n) (+ round 1)))
            (decreases (- degree edge_i))
            (let edge (tuple i64 i64)
              (idx
                (idx (field graph adj) candidate)
                edge_i))
            (let target i64 (get edge 0))
            (let weight i64 (get edge 1))
            (assert
              (has_edge
                (view graph)
                candidate
                target
                weight))
            (call edge_value graph candidate target weight)
            (assert
              (and (>= weight 0) (<= weight 100000)))
            (if
              (not (idx seen target))
              (if
                (or
                  (== (idx dist target) -1)
                  (< (+ best weight) (idx dist target)))
                (block
                  (ghost-let dist_before (seq int) dist)
                  (ghost-let wit_before (seq (seq int)) wit)
                  (ghost-set wit
                    (seq-build n
                      (fn (wit_j)
                        (if
                          (== wit_j target)
                          (concat
                            (idx wit_before candidate)
                            (seq-lit target))
                          (idx wit_before wit_j)))))
                  (set-idx dist target (+ best weight))
                  (assert
                    (upd
                      dist_before
                      dist
