              (and
                (not (idx seen candidate))
                (and (== best (idx dist candidate)) (>= best 0)))))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v upto))
                  (and (not (idx seen v)) (>= (idx dist v) 0)))
                (and (!= candidate -1)
                     (<= best (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn witnesses
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len wit) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (>= (idx dist v) 0))
          (and
            (is_path g (idx wit v))
            (and
              (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start)
              (and
                (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)
                (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn finalized
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq int)) (seen (seq bool)))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (< v (len seen)))
          (idx seen v))
        (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))))

(ghost-fn closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (seen (seq bool)))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=>
        (and
          (has_edge g u v w)
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist))) (< u (len seen)))
              (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (< v (len seen))))
            (and (idx seen u) (not (idx seen v)))))
        (and
          (>= (idx dist v) 0)
          (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w)))))))

(ghost-fn closed_except
  ((wg weighted_graph) (dist (seq int)) (seen (seq bool))
   (u int) (upto int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((x int) (v int) (w int))
        (=>
          (and
            (has_edge (view wg) x v w)
            (and
              (and
                (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (< x (len seen)))
                (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (< v (len seen))))
              (and
                (and (idx seen x) (!= x u))
                (not (idx seen v)))))
          (and
            (>= (idx dist v) 0)
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist x) w)))))
      (forall ((e int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (field wg adj))))
                (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist))))
              (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e upto))
                   (< e (len (idx (field wg adj) u)))))
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 0) (len dist)))
              (and
                (< (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 0) (len seen))
                (not (idx seen (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 0))))))
          (and
            (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 0)) 0)
            (<=
              (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 0))
              (+ (idx dist u)
                 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) e) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn upd
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before))
           (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before))) (!= i at))
            (== (idx after i) (idx before i))))))))

(ghost-fn updb
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int) (value bool))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before))
           (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before))) (!= i at))
            (== (idx after i) (idx before i))))))))

(ghost-fn updw
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int)))
   (at int) (value (seq int)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before))
           (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before))) (!= i at))
            (== (idx after i) (idx before i))))))))

(ghost-fn count_true ((s (seq bool)) (k int)) int
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      0
      (+ (count_true s (- k 1))
         (if (idx s (- k 1)) 1 0)))))

(lemma count_true_bounds
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (count_true s k))
         (<= (count_true s k) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_true_bounds s (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_true_false
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s)))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (count_true s k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_true_false s (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_true_update
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (at int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (updb before after at true)
    (not (idx before at))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len before))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (count_true after k)
      (+ (count_true before k) (if (< at k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_true_update before after at (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_true_full
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s)))
    (== (count_true s k) k))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (idx s i))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call count_true_bounds s (- k 1))
        (call count_true_full s (- k 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma weight_from_hit
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (hit int)
    (from int))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 0 from) (<= from hit))
      (and
        (< hit (len row))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row hit) 0) v)
          (and
            (== (get (idx row hit) 1) w)
            (forall ((i int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
                  (!= i hit))
                (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))))))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v from) w))
  (decreases (- hit from))
  (body
    (if (< from hit)
      (call weight_from_hit row v w hit (+ from 1))
      (block))))

(lemma edge_value
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg)))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))
  (body
    (obtain ((hit int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) hit) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) hit) 1) w))))
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (view wg) u))))
            (!= i hit))
          (!= (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0) v))))
    (call weight_from_hit (idx (view wg) u) v w hit 0)))

(lemma prefix_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p (+ k 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (+ k 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (+ i 1))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (and
        (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
        (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_edge g p k i))))

(lemma path_weight_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (and (< 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (has_edge (view wg) (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+ (path_weight (view wg) (take p k)) w)))
  (body
    (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)))

(lemma append_take_idx
  (params (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (idx (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) i)
      (idx p i)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)))

(lemma append_take
  (params (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (ensures
    (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p))
    (forall ((i int)) (call append_take_idx p v i))
    (call law_seq_ext
      (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p))
      p)))

(lemma append_path_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (assert
        (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (and
        (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
        (==
          (idx
            (concat p (seq-lit v))
            (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call append_path_point g p v w i))))

(lemma append_weight
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (has_edge (view wg) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call edge_value wg (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w)
    (call append_take p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))

(lemma witness_update_point
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (wit_before (seq (seq int)))
    (wit_after (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (witnesses (view wg) start before wit_before)
    (upd before after v x)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len before)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len wit_before)))
    (updw
      wit_before
      wit_after
      v
      (concat (idx wit_before u) (seq-lit v)))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ (idx before u) w))
    (!= u v))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len after))) (>= (idx after k) 0))
      (and
        (is_path (view wg) (idx wit_after k))
        (and
          (== (idx (idx wit_after k) 0) start)
          (and
            (== (idx (idx wit_after k) (- (len (idx wit_after k)) 1)) k)
            (== (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit_after k)) (idx after k)))))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len wit_before) (len before)))
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len after)))
        (>= (idx after k) 0))
      (if
        (== k v)
        (block
          (assert (is_path (view wg) (idx wit_before u)))
          (assert (> (len (idx wit_before u)) 0))
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx wit_before u) 0) start))
          (assert
            (==
              (idx
                (idx wit_before u)
                (- (len (idx wit_before u)) 1))
              u))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit_before u))
              (idx before u)))
          (call append_path
            (view wg)
            (idx wit_before u)
            v
            w)
          (call append_weight
            wg
            (idx wit_before u)
            v
            w))
        (block))
      (block))))

(lemma witness_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (wit_before (seq (seq int)))
    (wit_after (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (witnesses (view wg) start before wit_before)
    (upd before after v x)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len before)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len wit_before)))
    (updw
      wit_before
      wit_after
      v
      (concat (idx wit_before u) (seq-lit v)))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ (idx before u) w))
    (!= u v))
  (ensures
    (witnesses (view wg) start after wit_after))
  (body
    (assert (== (len wit_before) (len before)))
    (forall ((k int))
      (call witness_update_point
        wg start before after wit_before wit_after u v w x k))))

(lemma walk_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (idx dist (idx p k)))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        best)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (call law_idx_take p 1 0)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start)))
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_bound
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1) candidate best)
        (call path_weight_step wg p k w)))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
           (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (block
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            (idx p k)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
            (idx dist (idx p k)))))
      (if
        (== k 0)
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            best))
        (block
          (obtain ((step_w int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              step_w))
          (assert (>= step_w 0))
          (if
            (idx seen (idx p (- k 1)))
            (block
              (assert
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (idx p k))
                    (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) step_w))))
              (assert (<= best (idx dist (idx p k)))))
            (block))
          (assert
            (>=
              (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
              best)))))))

(lemma select_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 candidate) (< candidate (len dist)))
      (and
        (not (idx seen candidate))
        (and
          (== best (idx dist candidate))
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            candidate
            best)))))
  (body
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 candidate) (< candidate (len dist))))
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (idx wit candidate)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (idx wit candidate) 0) start))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx wit candidate) (- (len (idx wit candidate)) 1))
        candidate))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit candidate))
        best))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call walk_bound
        wg
        start
        dist
        seen
        p
        (- (len p) 1)
        candidate
        best))))

(lemma walk_seen
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) -1 -1)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures (idx seen (idx p k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (> k 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_seen
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1))
        (if
          (idx seen (idx p k))
          (block)
          (block
            (assert
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                (<=
                  (idx dist (idx p k))
                  (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) w))))
            (assert false))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (if
          (idx seen (idx p k))
          (block)
          (assert false))))))

(lemma no_candidate_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (>= round 0)
    (dist_range dist (size wg) round)
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (seen_range seen dist (size wg))
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)

    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p (+ k 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (+ k 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (+ i 1))))

  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)

(lemma walk_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (candidate int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len seen) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (finalized (view wg) start dist seen)
    (closed (view wg) dist seen)
    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (idx dist (idx p k)))
      (>=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
        best)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (call law_idx_take p 1 0)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start)))
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            w))
        (call edge_value wg (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len seen))))
        (call walk_bound
          wg start dist seen p (- k 1) candidate best)
        (call path_weight_step wg p k w)))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 (idx p k))
           (< (idx p k) (len seen))))
    (if
      (idx seen (idx p k))
      (block
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view wg)
            start
            (idx p k)
            (idx dist (idx p k))))
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
            (idx dist (idx p k)))))
      (if
        (== k 0)
        (assert
          (>=
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            best))
        (block
          (obtain ((step_w int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              step_w))
          (assert (>= step_w 0))
          (if
            (idx seen (idx p (- k 1)))
            (block
              (assert
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (idx p k))
                    (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) step_w))))
              (assert (<= best (idx dist (idx p k)))))
            (block))
          (assert
            (>=
              (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))
              best)))))))

(lemma select_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))

    (candidate_prefix dist seen (len dist) candidate best)
    (!= candidate -1))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 candidate) (< candidate (len dist)))

    (assert

        (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit candidate))
        best))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call walk_bound
        wg
        start
        dist
        seen
        p
        (- (len p) 1)
        candidate
        best))))

(lemma walk_seen
  (params

    (if

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (n int)
    (round int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (wit_before (seq (seq int)))
    (wit_after (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (== n (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 round) (< round n))
    (dist_range before n (+ round 1))
    (seen_range seen before n)
    (witnesses (view wg) start before wit_before)
    (finalized (view wg) start before seen)
    (closed_except wg before seen u i)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (idx seen u)
    (== (idx before start) 0)
    (<= (idx before u) (* round 100000))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (not (idx seen v))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (== x (+ (idx before u) w))
    (or (== (idx before v) -1) (< x (idx before v)))
    (upd before after v x)
    (updw
      wit_before
      wit_after
      v
      (concat (idx wit_before u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures
    (dist_range after n (+ round 1))
    (seen_range seen after n)
    (witnesses (view wg) start after wit_after)
    (finalized (view wg) start after seen)
    (closed_except wg after seen u (+ i 1))
    (== (idx after start) (idx before start))
    (== (idx after u) (idx before u)))
  (body
    (call edge_value wg u v w)
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (>= x 0))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert (<= x (* (+ round 1) 100000)))
    (assert (== (len wit_before) (len before)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len wit_before))))
    (call witness_update
      wg start before after wit_before wit_after u v w x)))

(spec dijkstra_candidate_step
  (params
    (dist (ref (slice i64)))
    (seen (ref (slice bool)))
    (upto i64)
    (candidate i64)
    (best i64))
  (returns (next_candidate i64) (next_best i64))
  (requires
    (candidate_prefix dist seen upto candidate best)

                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                (=> (or
                      (and
                        (introduced_by edges k u)
                        (not
                          (introduced_by edges k
                            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
                      (and
                        (introduced_by edges k
                          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                        (not (introduced_by edges k u))))
                  (<=
                    (get (idx edges k) 2)
                    (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_min
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (seen (seq bool))
   (outer int)
   (inner int)
   (found bool)
   (best int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((u int) (i int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                (and
                  (or (< u outer) (and (== u outer) (< i inner)))
                  (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
          (and found (<= best (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
      (=>
        found
        (exists ((u int) (i int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
              (and
                (or (< u outer) (and (== u outer) (< i inner)))
                (and
                  (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                  (== best (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))))

(lemma selected_count_all_false

(lemma selected_count_flip
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len after) (len before))

    (not (idx before v))
    (idx after v)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
            (!= k v))
          (== (idx after k) (idx before k)))))
  (ensures
    (== (selected_count after)
        (+ (selected_count before) 1)))
  (decreases (len before))
  (body
    (if (== v 0)
      (block
        (assert (not (idx before 0)))
        (assert (idx after 0))
        (assert (== (len (drop after 1)) (len (drop before 1))))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (drop before 1))))
                (== (idx (drop after 1) j)
                    (idx (drop before 1) j)))))
        (call selected_count_same
          (drop after 1)
          (drop before 1)))
      (block
        (assert (> v 0))
        (assert (== (idx after 0) (idx before 0)))
        (assert (== (len (drop after 1)) (len (drop before 1))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (- v 1))
            (< (- v 1) (len (drop before 1)))))
        (assert
          (not (idx (drop before 1) (- v 1))))
        (assert
          (idx (drop after 1) (- v 1)))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 j)
                    (< j (len (drop before 1))))
                  (!= j (- v 1)))
                (== (idx (drop after 1) j)
                    (idx (drop before 1) j)))))
        (call selected_count_flip
          (drop before 1)
          (drop after 1)
          (- v 1))))))

(lemma path_change
  (params
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (marked seen (idx p 0))
    (not (marked seen (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
        (crosses seen (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (if (marked seen (idx p (- k 1)))
        (assert
          (exists ((j int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))

        (block
          (call path_change seen p (- k 1))
          (assert

(lemma connected_has_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (idx seen 0)
    (== (selected_count seen) count)
    (and (<= 1 count) (< count (len g))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))))
  (body
    (call selected_count_lt_has_unseen seen count)
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen v))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (marked seen (idx p 0)))
    (assert (not (marked seen (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call path_change seen p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
        (crosses seen (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert
      (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g (idx p j))))))
        (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) i) 0)
            (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert
      (exists ((u int) (i2 int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u))))
            (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i2) 0)))))))

(lemma prim_prefix_step_at
  (params

    (u int)

    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (has_edge g
        (get (idx edges k) 0)
        (get (idx edges k) 1)
        (get (idx edges k) 2))
      (and
        (or
          (and
            (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 0))
            (not (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 1))))
          (and
            (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 1))

        (forall ((x int) (i int))
          (=> (and
                (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))

            (=> (or
                  (and
                    (introduced_by edges k x)

                      (introduced_by edges k
                        (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
                  (and
                    (introduced_by edges k
                      (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))
                    (not (introduced_by edges k x))))

                (get (idx edges k) 2)
                (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1))))))))
  (body
    (if (< k (len edges0))
      (block
        (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
        (call law_len_concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
        (call law_idx_concat
          edges0
          (seq-lit (tuple u v w))
          k))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len edges0)))
        (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
        (call law_len_concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
        (call law_idx_concat
          edges0
          (seq-lit (tuple u v w))

        (call law_contains_unit (tuple u v w) (tuple u v w))))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut in_tree (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (k) (== k 0))))
    (call selected_count_initial n)
    (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call prim_prefix_empty (view graph))
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant (and (<= 1 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len in_tree) n))
      (invariant (idx in_tree 0))
      (invariant (== (selected_count in_tree) count))
      (invariant (== (len edges) (- count 1)))
      (invariant (prim_prefix (view graph) edges))
      (invariant
        (forall ((x int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
            (== (idx in_tree x)
                (introduced_by edges (len edges) x)))))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_u i64 0)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_new i64 0)
      (let-mut best_w i64 0)
      (call scan_min_none (view graph) in_tree)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (== (len in_tree) n))
        (invariant (scan_min (view graph) in_tree u 0 found best_w))
        (invariant
          (=>
            found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best_u) (< best_u n))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v n))
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 best_new) (< best_new n))
                  (and
                    (has_edge (view graph) best_u best_v best_w)
                    (and
                      (crosses in_tree best_u best_v)
                      (and
                        (not (idx in_tree best_new))
                        (or
                          (and
                            (== best_new best_u)
                            (not (idx in_tree best_u)))
                          (and
                            (== best_new best_v)
                            (not (idx in_tree best_v))))))))))))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (let-mut i i64 0)
        (while (< i deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
          (invariant (== (len in_tree) n))
          (invariant (scan_min (view graph) in_tree u i found best_w))
          (invariant
            (=>
              found
              (and
                (and (<= 0 best_u) (< best_u n))
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v n))
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 best_new) (< best_new n))
                    (and
                      (has_edge (view graph) best_u best_v best_w)
                      (and
                        (crosses in_tree best_u best_v)
                        (and
                          (not (idx in_tree best_new))
                          (or
                            (and
                              (== best_new best_u)
                              (not (idx in_tree best_u)))
                            (and
                              (== best_new best_v)
                              (not (idx in_tree best_v))))))))))))

            (< j (len edges)))
          (or
            (== (get (idx edges j) 0) v)
            (== (get (idx edges j) 1) v)))))))

(ghost-fn prim_prefix
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges)))
        (and
          (has_edge g
            (get (idx edges k) 0)
            (get (idx edges k) 1)
            (get (idx edges k) 2))
          (and
            (or
              (and
                (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 0))
                (not (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 1))))
              (and
                (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 1))
                (not (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 0)))))
            (forall ((u int) (i int))
              (=> (and
                    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                (=> (or
                      (and
                        (introduced_by edges k u)
                        (not
                          (introduced_by edges k
                            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
                      (and
                        (introduced_by edges k
                          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                        (not (introduced_by edges k u))))
                  (<=
                    (get (idx edges k) 2)
                    (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_min
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (seen (seq bool))
   (outer int)
   (inner int)
   (found bool)
   (best int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((u int) (i int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                (and
                  (or (< u outer) (and (== u outer) (< i inner)))
                  (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
          (and found (<= best (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
      (=>
        found
        (exists ((u int) (i int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
              (and
                (or (< u outer) (and (== u outer) (< i inner)))
                (and
                  (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                  (== best (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))))

(lemma scan_min_none
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool)))
  (ensures (scan_min g seen 0 0 false 0))
  (body))

(lemma scan_min_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (scan_min g seen u i found best)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (not (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (ensures (scan_min g seen u (+ i 1) found best))
  (body))

  (params

(lemma scan_min_take
  (params

    (or (not found) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) best)))
  (ensures

      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))

(lemma selected_count_all_false
  (params (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len seen)))
          (not (idx seen k)))))
  (ensures (== (selected_count seen) 0))
  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (if (> (len seen) 0)
      (block
        (assert (not (idx seen 0)))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (drop seen 1))))
                (not (idx (drop seen 1) j)))))
        (call selected_count_all_false (drop seen 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma selected_count_initial
  (params (n int))
  (requires (> n 0))
  (ensures
    (== (selected_count
      (seq-build n (fn (k) (== k 0)))) 1))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=> (and
              (<= 0 j)
              (< j
                (len
                  (drop
                    (seq-build n (fn (k) (== k 0)))
                    1))))
            (not
              (idx
                (drop
                  (seq-build n (fn (k) (== k 0)))
                  1)
                j)))))
    (call selected_count_all_false
      (drop (seq-build n (fn (k) (== k 0))) 1))))

(lemma selected_count_same
  (params
    (a (seq bool))
    (b (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (== (len a) (len b))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (== (idx a k) (idx b k)))))
  (ensures (== (selected_count a) (selected_count b)))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body
    (if (> (len a) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx a 0) (idx b 0)))
        (assert (== (len (drop a 1)) (len (drop b 1))))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (drop a 1))))
                (== (idx (drop a 1) j)
                    (idx (drop b 1) j)))))
        (call selected_count_same (drop a 1) (drop b 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma selected_count_flip
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
    (not (idx before v))
    (idx after v)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
            (!= k v))
          (== (idx after k) (idx before k)))))
  (ensures
    (== (selected_count after)
        (+ (selected_count before) 1)))
  (decreases (len before))
  (body
    (if (== v 0)
      (block
        (assert (not (idx before 0)))
        (assert (idx after 0))
        (assert (== (len (drop after 1)) (len (drop before 1))))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (drop before 1))))
                (== (idx (drop after 1) j)
                    (idx (drop before 1) j)))))
        (call selected_count_same
          (drop after 1)
          (drop before 1)))
      (block
        (assert (> v 0))
        (assert (== (idx after 0) (idx before 0)))
        (assert (== (len (drop after 1)) (len (drop before 1))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (- v 1))
            (< (- v 1) (len (drop before 1)))))
        (assert
          (not (idx (drop before 1) (- v 1))))
        (assert
          (idx (drop after 1) (- v 1)))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 j)
                    (< j (len (drop before 1))))
                  (!= j (- v 1)))
                (== (idx (drop after 1) j)
                    (idx (drop before 1) j)))))
        (call selected_count_flip
          (drop before 1)
          (drop after 1)
          (- v 1))))))

(lemma selected_count_step
  (params
    (seen0 (seq bool))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (v int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len seen) (len seen0))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen0)))

    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len seen0)))
            (!= k v))
          (== (idx seen k) (idx seen0 k))))
    (== (selected_count seen0) count))
  (ensures (== (selected_count seen) (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (call selected_count_flip seen0 seen v)))

(lemma selected_count_lt_has_unseen
  (params
    (seen (seq bool))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (selected_count seen) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len seen))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen v)))))
  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (if (not (idx seen 0))
      (assert
        (exists ((v int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
            (not (idx seen v)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len seen) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (selected_count (drop seen 1))
            (- count 1)))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (- count 1))
            (< (- count 1) (len (drop seen 1)))))
        (call selected_count_lt_has_unseen
          (drop seen 1)
          (- count 1))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 j)
              (< j (len (drop seen 1))))
            (not (idx (drop seen 1) j))))
        (assert
          (exists ((v int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
              (not (idx seen v)))))))))

(lemma selected_count_full
  (params

  (requires
    (== (selected_count seen) (len seen)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))

  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (if (> (len seen) 0)
      (block
        (assert (idx seen 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (selected_count (drop seen 1))
            (len (drop seen 1))))
        (call selected_count_full (drop seen 1)))

(lemma path_change
  (params
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (marked seen (idx p 0))
    (not (marked seen (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
        (crosses seen (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (if (marked seen (idx p (- k 1)))
        (assert
          (exists ((j int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
              (crosses seen (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))))
        (block
          (call path_change seen p (- k 1))
          (assert
            (exists ((j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
                (crosses seen (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))))))
      (assert false))))

(lemma connected_has_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (idx seen 0)
    (== (selected_count seen) count)
    (and (<= 1 count) (< count (len g))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))))
  (body
    (call selected_count_lt_has_unseen seen count)
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen v))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (marked seen (idx p 0)))
    (assert (not (marked seen (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call path_change seen p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
        (crosses seen (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert
      (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g (idx p j))))))
        (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) i) 0)
            (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert
      (exists ((u int) (i2 int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u))))
            (crosses seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i2) 0))))))))

(lemma full_scan_found
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))

  (requires

(lemma prim_prefix_step_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (prim_prefix g edges0)
    (== (len edges0) (- (selected_count seen) 1))
    (idx seen 0)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len seen)))
          (== (idx seen x)
              (introduced_by edges0 (len edges0) x))))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (crosses seen u v)
    (forall ((x int) (i int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x))))
              (crosses seen x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
          (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1))))
    (== edges (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (has_edge g
        (get (idx edges k) 0)
        (get (idx edges k) 1)
        (get (idx edges k) 2))
      (and
        (or
          (and
            (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 0))
            (not (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 1))))
          (and
            (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 1))
            (not (introduced_by edges k (get (idx edges k) 0)))))
        (forall ((x int) (i int))
          (=> (and
                (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
            (=> (or
                  (and
                    (introduced_by edges k x)
                    (not
                      (introduced_by edges k
                        (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
                  (and
                    (introduced_by edges k
                      (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))
                    (not (introduced_by edges k x))))
              (<=
                (get (idx edges k) 2)
                (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1))))))))
  (body
    (if (< k (len edges0))
      (block
        (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
        (call law_len_concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
        (call law_idx_concat
          edges0
          (seq-lit (tuple u v w))
          k))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len edges0)))
        (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
        (call law_len_concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
        (call law_idx_concat
          edges0
          (seq-lit (tuple u v w))
          k)
        (call law_contains_unit (tuple u v w) (tuple u v w))))))

(lemma introduced_step

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut in_tree (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (k) (== k 0))))
    (call selected_count_initial n)
    (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call prim_prefix_empty (view graph))
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant (and (<= 1 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len in_tree) n))
      (invariant (idx in_tree 0))
      (invariant (== (selected_count in_tree) count))
      (invariant (== (len edges) (- count 1)))
      (invariant (prim_prefix (view graph) edges))
      (invariant
        (forall ((x int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
            (== (idx in_tree x)
                (introduced_by edges (len edges) x)))))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_u i64 0)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_new i64 0)
      (let-mut best_w i64 0)
      (call scan_min_none (view graph) in_tree)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (== (len in_tree) n))
        (invariant (scan_min (view graph) in_tree u 0 found best_w))
        (invariant
          (=>
            found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best_u) (< best_u n))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v n))
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 best_new) (< best_new n))
                  (and
                    (has_edge (view graph) best_u best_v best_w)
                    (and
                      (crosses in_tree best_u best_v)
                      (and
                        (not (idx in_tree best_new))
                        (or
                          (and
                            (== best_new best_u)
                            (not (idx in_tree best_u)))
                          (and
                            (== best_new best_v)
                            (not (idx in_tree best_v))))))))))))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))

    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (* n n)))
    (and

        (cap_scan

  (ensures

      (matrix_put f n (/ p n) (% p n) x)

  (body))

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g
            (/ p n)
            (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires

    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))

      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q)))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1)))
        (block
          (assert
            (==
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0))))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))))))

(lemma positive_has_capacity
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (matrix_ok g f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((c int))
      (and
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))
  (body
    (assert
      (>
        (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u)))
        0))
    (call cap_scan_positive
      (idx g u)
      v
      (len (idx g u)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (==
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)
            (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u)))))))
    (assert
      (has_capacity
        g
        u
        v
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

(lemma search_correct
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t))
  (ensures
    (exists ((f (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (is_max_flow g f s t)
        (==
          (flow_val g f s)
          (search_space g (zero_matrix n) n s t 0 0)))))
  (body
    (call zero_candidate g n s t)
    (call search_upper
      g
      (zero_matrix n)
      (zero_matrix n)
      n s t 0 0)
    (assert
      (>=
        (search_space g (zero_matrix n) n s t 0 0)
        0))
    (call search_witness
      g
      (zero_matrix n)
      n s t 0 0)
    (obtain ((best (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g (zero_matrix n) best n 0 0)
        (==
          (candidate_score g best s t)
          (search_space g (zero_matrix n) n s t 0 0))))
    (assert (is_conserved g best s t))
    (call matrix_is_valid g best n s t)
    (assert
      (==
        (flow_val g best s)
        (search_space g (zero_matrix n) n s t 0 0)))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int))))
      (call every_flow_below_search g other n s t))
    (assert (is_max_flow g best s t))))

(spec evaluate_candidate
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (f (vec (vec i64)))
    (n i64)
    (s i64)
    (t i64))
  (returns
    (score i64)
    (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (matrix_ok g f n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== score (candidate_score g f s t))
    (== r f))
  (effects))

(def evaluate_candidate
  (body
    (let-mut all_good bool true)
    (let-mut vertex i64 0)
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (while (< vertex n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 vertex) (<= vertex n)))
      (invariant
        (==
          all_good
          (checked_conservation g f s t vertex)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 source_out)
          (<= source_out 100000000)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 source_in)
          (<= source_in 100000000)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (< s vertex)
          (and
            (== source_out (total_flow_out g f s))
            (== source_in (total_flow_in g f s)))))
      (decreases (- n vertex))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut edge_pos i64 0)
      (while (< edge_pos (len (idx g vertex)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_pos)
            (<= edge_pos (len (idx g vertex)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive g f vertex edge_pos)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing 100000000)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx g vertex)) edge_pos))
        (let endpoint i64
          (get (idx (idx g vertex) edge_pos) 0))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx (idx f vertex) endpoint))
            (<= (idx (idx f vertex) endpoint) 100000)))
        (set outgoing
          (+ outgoing (idx (idx f vertex) endpoint)))
        (set edge_pos (+ edge_pos 1)))
      (assert
        (== outgoing (total_flow_out g f vertex)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut from_pos i64 0)
      (while (< from_pos n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 from_pos) (<= from_pos n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive g f vertex from_pos)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming (* 100000 from_pos))))
        (decreases (- n from_pos))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx (idx f from_pos) vertex))
            (<= (idx (idx f from_pos) vertex) 100000)))
        (set incoming
          (+ incoming (idx (idx f from_pos) vertex)))
        (set from_pos (+ from_pos 1)))
      (assert
        (== incoming (total_flow_in g f vertex)))

              (search_space g f n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put f n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g f n s t p (+ x 1))))))))

(ghost-fn completion
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (base (seq (seq int)))
   (f (seq (seq int)))
   (n int)
   (p int)
   (x int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== n (len g))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
        (and
          (matrix_ok g f n)
          (and
            (prefix_same base f n p)
            (=>
              (< p (* n n))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
                (>= (idx (idx f (/ p n)) (% p n)) x)))))))))

(ghost-fn checked_conservation
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (f (seq (seq int)))
   (s int)
   (t int)
   (k int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u k))
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (==
          (total_flow_in g f u)
          (total_flow_out g f u))))))

(ghost-fn normalized
  ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) (seq (seq int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (body
    (seq-build n
      (fn (u)
        (seq-build n
          (fn (v) (get_flow f u v)))))))

(lemma cap_scan_bound
  (params

  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (cap_scan (idx g u) v k))
      (<= (cap_scan (idx g u) v k) 100000)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call cap_scan_bound g u v (- k 1))

(lemma cap_scan_positive
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len row)))

  (ensures
    (exists ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i k))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx row i) 1) (cap_scan row v k))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (> k 0))
    (if (== (get (idx row (- k 1)) 0) v)
      (assert
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) k))
          (and
            (== (get (idx row (- k 1)) 0) v)

(lemma cap_scan_edge
  (params

  (requires

  (body
    (if (> k (+ i 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (call cap_scan_edge g u i (- k 1)))

(lemma completion_from_take
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))

    (x int))

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q)))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1)))
        (block
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0))))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))))

(lemma positive_has_capacity
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))

    (u int)

  (requires
    (graph_form g)

  (body
    (assert
      (> (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))) 0))

(lemma matrix_is_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (s int)

  (requires
    (graph_form g)

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)

    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))

    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v))
      (<=
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
  (body
    (call cap_scan_bound g u v (len (idx g u)))
    (call normalized_get other n u v)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)

      (and
        (< u (len other))

      (assert (>= (get_flow other u v) 0))
      (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0)))

          (and
            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow other u v) c)))
        (call cap_scan_has_capacity g u v c)
        (assert
          (<=
            (get_flow other u v)
            (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0))))))

(lemma normalized_properties
  (params

    (graph_form g)
