    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (cap_scan (idx g u) v k))
      (<= (cap_scan (idx g u) v k) 100000)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call cap_scan_bound g u v (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma cap_scan_positive
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len row)))
    (> (cap_scan row v k) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i k))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx row i) 1) (cap_scan row v k))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (> k 0))
    (if (== (get (idx row (- k 1)) 0) v)
      (assert
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) k))
          (and
            (== (get (idx row (- k 1)) 0) v)
            (==
              (get (idx row (- k 1)) 1)
              (cap_scan row v k)))))
      (call cap_scan_positive row v (- k 1)))))

(lemma cap_scan_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i k))
      (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (cap_scan
        (idx g u)
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
        k)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (> k (+ i 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (call cap_scan_edge g u i (- k 1)))
      (assert (== k (+ i 1))))))

(lemma cap_scan_has_capacity
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (c int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures
    (== (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call cap_scan_edge g u i (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma put_properties
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix f n)
    (prefix_ok g f n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (* n n)))
    (and
      (<= 0 x)
      (<= x
        (cap_scan
          (idx g (/ p n))
          (% p n)
          (len (idx g (/ p n)))))))
  (ensures
    (square_matrix (matrix_put f n (/ p n) (% p n) x) n)
    (prefix_ok
      g
      (matrix_put f n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      n
      (+ p 1))
    (prefix_same
      f
      (matrix_put f n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      n
      p))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_weaken
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (a int)
    (b int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 a) (<= a b))
    (prefix_ok g f n b))
  (ensures (prefix_ok g f n a))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_same_weaken
  (params
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (q int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p q))
    (prefix_same a b n q))
  (ensures (prefix_same a b n p))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_same_trans
  (params
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (c (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int))
  (requires
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (prefix_same b c n p))
  (ensures (prefix_same a c n p))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_row_equal
  (params
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_same a b n (* n n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (idx a u) (idx b u)))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_full_equal
  (params
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (prefix_same a b n (* n n)))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (call prefix_row_equal a b n u))))

(lemma put_frame
  (params
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (* n n))))
  (ensures
    (prefix_same
      (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      n
      (+ p 1)))
  (body))

(lemma completion_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (completion g base q n p (+ x 1))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x 100001)))
  (ensures (completion g base q n p x))
  (body))

(lemma completion_take
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (* n n)))
    (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x)
    (prefix_ok g base n p))
  (ensures
    (completion
      g
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      q n (+ p 1) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== n (len g)))
    (assert (matrix_ok g q n))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 x)
        (<= x
          (cap_scan
            (idx g (/ p n))
            (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n)))))))
    (call put_properties g base n p x)))

(lemma completion_from_take
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (* n n)))
    (and
      (<= 0 x)
      (<= x
        (cap_scan
          (idx g (/ p n))
          (% p n)
          (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
    (completion
      g
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      q n (+ p 1) 0))
  (ensures (completion g base q n p x))
  (body
    (call put_properties g base n p x)
    (call prefix_same_weaken
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      q n p (+ p 1))
    (call prefix_same_trans
      base
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      q n p)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
        x))))

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q)))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1)))
        (block
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0))))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))))

(lemma positive_has_capacity
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (matrix_ok g f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((c int))
      (and
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))
  (body
    (assert
      (> (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))) 0))
    (call cap_scan_positive
      (idx g u) v (len (idx g u)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (==
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)
            (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u)))))))
    (assert
      (has_capacity
        g u v
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

(lemma matrix_cell_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (matrix_ok g f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (idx f u) v))
      (<= (idx (idx f u) v) 100000)))
  (body
    (call cap_scan_bound
      g u v (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma matrix_is_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (matrix_ok g f n)
    (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call positive_has_capacity g f n u v))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (=>
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
            (exists ((c int))
              (and
                (has_capacity g u v c)
                (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))))

(lemma normalized_get
  (params
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (get_flow (normalized f n) u v)
      (get_flow f u v)))
  (body))

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v))
      (<=
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
  (body
    (call cap_scan_bound g u v (len (idx g u)))
    (call normalized_get other n u v)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (get_flow other u v)))
    (if
      (and
        (< u (len other))
        (< v (len (idx other u))))
      (assert (>= (get_flow other u v) 0))
      (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0)))
    (if (> (get_flow other u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity g u v c)
              (<= (get_flow other u v) c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow other u v) c)))
        (call cap_scan_has_capacity g u v c)
        (assert
          (<=
            (get_flow other u v)
            (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0))))))

(lemma normalized_out_sum
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_out_recursive g (normalized other n) u k)
      (sum_flow_out_recursive g other u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call normalized_out_sum g other n u (- k 1))
        (call normalized_get
          other n u
          (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma normalized_in_sum
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_in_recursive g (normalized other n) u k)
      (sum_flow_in_recursive g other u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call normalized_in_sum g other n u (- k 1))
        (call normalized_get other n (- k 1) u))
      (block))))

(lemma normalized_totals
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (total_flow_out g (normalized other n) u)
      (total_flow_out g other u))
    (==
      (total_flow_in g (normalized other n) u)
      (total_flow_in g other u)))
  (body
    (call normalized_out_sum
      g other n u (len (idx g u)))
    (call normalized_in_sum g other n u n)))

(lemma normalized_properties
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures
    (matrix_ok g (normalized other n) n)
    (is_conserved g (normalized other n) s t)
    (==
      (flow_val g (normalized other n) s)
      (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call normalized_cell g other n s t u v))
    (assert (square_matrix (normalized other n) n))
    (assert (matrix_ok g (normalized other n) n))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call normalized_totals g other n u))
    (assert (is_conserved g (normalized other n) s t))
    (call normalized_totals g other n s)))

(lemma every_flow_below_search
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (flow_val g other s)
      (search_space g (zero_matrix n) n s t 0 0)))
  (body
    (call normalized_properties g other n s t)
    (call search_upper
      g
      (zero_matrix n)
      (normalized other n)
      n s t 0 0)))

  (requires

(lemma zero_totals
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (n int)
    (u int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g (zero_matrix n) u) 0)
    (== (total_flow_in g (zero_matrix n) u) 0))

  (params

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q))
        (assert
          (==
            (search_space g base n s t p x)
            (candidate_score g base s t))))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1))
          (assert
            (<=
              (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1))
              (search_space g base n s t p x))))
        (block
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0)
          (assert
            (<=
              (search_space
                g
                (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))))

        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (call cap_scan_edge g u i (- k 1)))
      (assert (== k (+ i 1))))))

(lemma cap_scan_has_capacity
  (params

  (requires

          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call cap_scan_edge g u i (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma completion_from_take
  (params

    (base (seq (seq int)))

    (p int)
    (x int))

    (and

        (cap_scan

    (completion

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q))
        (assert
          (==
            (search_space g base n s t p x)
            (candidate_score g base s t))))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1))
          (assert
            (<=
              (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1))
              (search_space g base n s t p x))))
        (block
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0)
          (assert
            (<=
              (search_space
                g
                (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))))

(lemma positive_has_capacity
  (params

        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))
  (body
    (assert
      (> (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))) 0))
    (call cap_scan_positive

    (obtain ((i int))

        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

          (==

(lemma matrix_is_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))

    (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (assert (square_matrix f n))
    (assert (== (len f) n))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call positive_has_capacity g f n u v))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (=>
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
            (exists ((c int))
              (and
                (has_capacity g u v c)
                (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))))

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v))
      (<=
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
  (body
    (call cap_scan_bound g u v (len (idx g u)))
    (call normalized_get other n u v)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (get_flow other u v)))
    (if
      (and
        (< u (len other))
        (< v (len (idx other u))))
      (assert (>= (get_flow other u v) 0))
      (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0)))
    (if (> (get_flow other u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity g u v c)
              (<= (get_flow other u v) c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow other u v) c)))
        (call cap_scan_has_capacity g u v c)
        (assert
          (<=
            (get_flow other u v)
            (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
      (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0)))))

(lemma completion_from_take

        (cap_scan

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q))
        (assert
          (==
            (search_space g base n s t p x)
            (candidate_score g base s t))))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1))
          (assert
            (<=
              (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1))
              (search_space g base n s t p x))))
        (block
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0)
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call search_take_le g base n s t p x)))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))))

(lemma positive_has_capacity
  (params

  (body

        g u v
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

              (get (idx row (- k 1)) 1)
              (cap_scan row v k)))))
      (call cap_scan_positive row v (- k 1)))))

(lemma cap_scan_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i k))
      (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (cap_scan
        (idx g u)
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
        k)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (> k (+ i 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (call cap_scan_edge g u i (- k 1)))
      (assert (== k (+ i 1))))))

(lemma cap_scan_has_capacity
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (c int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures
    (== (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call cap_scan_edge g u i (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma completion_from_take
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (* n n)))
    (and
      (<= 0 x)
      (<= x
        (cap_scan
          (idx g (/ p n))
          (% p n)
          (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
    (completion
      g
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      q n (+ p 1) 0))
  (ensures (completion g base q n p x))
  (body
    (assert (== n (len g)))
    (assert (matrix_ok g q n))
    (assert
      (prefix_same
        (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
        q n (+ p 1)))
    (call put_properties g base n p x)
    (assert
      (prefix_same
        base
        (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
        n p))
    (call prefix_same_weaken
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)

    (call prefix_same_trans
      base
      (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
      q n p)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
        x))
    (call cap_scan_bound
      g
      (/ p n)
      (% p n)
      (len (idx g (/ p n))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 p)
        (<= p (* n n))))
    (assert (prefix_same base q n p))
    (assert
      (>=
        (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
        x))
    (assert (completion g base q n p x))))

(lemma search_frame
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix a n)
    (square_matrix b n)
    (prefix_ok g a n p)
    (prefix_ok g b n p)
    (prefix_same a b n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (search_space g a n s t p x)
      (search_space g b n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal a b n)
        (assert (== a b)))
      (if (== x 100001)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (if
            (<= x
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n)))))
            (block
              (call put_properties g a n p x)
              (call put_properties g b n p x)
              (call put_frame a b n p x)
              (call search_frame
                g
                (matrix_put a n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                (matrix_put b n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                n s t (+ p 1) 0)
              (call search_frame g a b n s t p (+ x 1)))
            (block)))))))

(lemma search_take_le
  (params

    (x int))

        g

  (body))

(lemma search_upper
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (q (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (completion g base q n p x)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (candidate_score g q s t)
      (search_space g base n s t p x)))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (call prefix_full_equal base q n)
        (assert (== base q))
        (assert
          (==
            (search_space g base n s t p x)
            (candidate_score g base s t))))
      (if
        (< x (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)))
        (block
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n))
              (cap_scan
                (idx g (/ p n))
                (% p n)
                (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call completion_skip g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper g base q n s t p (+ x 1))
          (assert
            (<=
              (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1))
              (search_space g base n s t p x))))
        (block
          (assert
            (== (idx (idx q (/ p n)) (% p n)) x))
          (call completion_take g base q n p x)
          (call search_upper
            g
            (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
            q n s t (+ p 1) 0)
          (call cap_scan_bound
            g (/ p n) (% p n)
            (len (idx g (/ p n))))
          (assert (< x 100001))
          (call search_take_le g base n s t p x)))))

(lemma search_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (p int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (square_matrix base n)
    (prefix_ok g base n p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001))
    (>= (search_space g base n s t p x) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (completion g base q n p x)
        (==
          (candidate_score g q s t)
          (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
  (decreases
    (+ (* (- (* n n) p) 100002) (- 100001 x)))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (assert (completion g base base n p x))
        (assert
          (==
            (candidate_score g base s t)
            (search_space g base n s t p x))))
      (block
        (assert (< x 100001))
        (assert
          (<= x
            (cap_scan
              (idx g (/ p n))
              (% p n)
              (len (idx g (/ p n))))))
        (call put_properties g base n p x)
        (if
          (>=
            (search_space
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))
          (block
            (call search_witness
              g
              (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
              n s t (+ p 1) 0)
            (obtain ((q1 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion
                  g
                  (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                  q1 n (+ p 1) 0)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space
                    g
                    (matrix_put base n (/ p n) (% p n) x)
                    n s t (+ p 1) 0))))
            (call completion_from_take g base q1 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q1 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q1 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x)))))
          (block
            (call search_witness g base n s t p (+ x 1))
            (obtain ((q2 (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p (+ x 1))
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p (+ x 1)))))
            (call completion_skip g base q2 n p x)
            (assert
              (and
                (completion g base q2 n p x)
                (==
                  (candidate_score g q2 s t)
                  (search_space g base n s t p x))))))))))

(lemma positive_has_capacity
  (params

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v))
      (<=
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
  (body
    (call cap_scan_bound g u v (len (idx g u)))
    (call normalized_get other n u v)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (idx (normalized other n) u) v)
        (get_flow other u v)))
    (if
      (and
        (< u (len other))
        (< v (len (idx other u))))
      (assert (>= (get_flow other u v) 0))
      (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0)))
    (if (> (get_flow other u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity g u v c)
              (<= (get_flow other u v) c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow other u v) c)))
        (call cap_scan_has_capacity g u v c)
        (assert
          (<=
            (get_flow other u v)
            (cap_scan (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))))))
      (assert (== (get_flow other u v) 0)))))

  (body

(lemma normalized_properties
  (params

(lemma every_flow_below_search
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (other (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_form g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (flow_val g other s)
      (search_space g (zero_matrix n) n s t 0 0)))
  (body
    (call normalized_properties g other n s t)
    (call search_upper
